title: Meta Campaign launcher
description:
We are a direct-to-consumer beauty & skincare brand selling to the Canadian (Quebec) market. We run Meta 
/Instagram) campaigns and need a detail-obsessed operator to build and launch campaigns from pre-approved assets.



This is a pure execution role. You will NOT write copy, design creatives, choose targeting, or manage budgets. Everything is handed to you ready to go. Your job is to assemble campaigns correctly in Meta Ads Manager, follow our naming and compliance checklist exactly, and launch in small controlled batches.



Important: all work is done inside a dedicated browser profile that we set up and assign to you. You must work only within that profile and follow our access instructions exactly — no logging in from your own browser or other devices. This is non-negotiable for account safety.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Pull approved creatives and copy from our Google Drive

Build campaigns / ad sets / ads manually in Meta Ads Manager

Follow our exact naming convention on every campaign, ad set, and ad (format: Product_Angle_Format_Date_Version)

Complete a short compliance checklist per ad before launch (correct copy used, required disclosure present)

Launch in small phased batches — never bulk-launch — on the schedule we give you

Update task status in ClickUp at each stage so we always know what's live, pending, or blocked

Flag anything that looks off (wrong file, mismatched copy, missing asset) BEFORE it goes live



TOOLS YOU MUST KNOW (or learn fast)



Meta Ads Manager / Business Manager (hands-on, manual campaign building)

ClickUp

Google Drive



WHO THIS IS FOR



You have launched real Meta campaigns before, manually in Ads Manager (tell us how many / what scale)

You are process-driven and never skip a checklist step

You follow instructions literally and ask before improvising

You communicate status daily

You are comfortable working inside a managed/assigned browser profile and following strict access rules

French is NOT required — copy is provided; you just place it correctly



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word MONTREAL so we know you read this fully. Applications without it are deleted.

Tell us how many Meta campaigns you've launched manually in Ads Manager, and at what scale.

One sentence on why precision matters in ad launching.



HOW WE HIRE

We start with one small paid test task (build + stage a single campaign to spec). If it's accurate, we move to an ongoing part-time arrangement. Payment is per completed, approved deliverable.

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Reels / TikTok / Shorts)
description:
About the Role



We're a boutique branding studio based in the Netherlands. We work at the intersection of brand identity, strategy, and design execution, and everything we put out, including our short-form video, is expected to feel as considered as the brands we build.



We're looking for a skilled short-form video editor to join us on a gig basis, with a clear path toward part-time and eventually full-time collaboration for the right person. You'll receive a brief, brand deliverables, and a kick-off call, then own the edit from start to finish. Part of the work involves editing AI-generated footage (e.g. Kling, Runway) into finished, brand-grade reels, so comfort working with generated clips, and the imperfections that come with them, is essential.



This is not an entry-level role, and it is NOT for someone who just started editing and is looking to grow into the work. We need someone who has already done this at a high level, repeatedly, and can prove it with published work.



What You'll Do



- Receive project briefs via online meeting and written documentation, then independently own full short-form edits

- Cut vertical (9:16) reels for a range of brand contexts, including narrative pieces, product content, studio content, and more

- Design and animate captions and titles in the brand's typeface, kinetic typography that looks intentional rather than default auto-caption

- Handle sound design: choose and cut music, sync cuts to the beat, and time drops and hits so the edit lands emotionally

- Colour grade and unify footage from mixed sources, including AI-generated clips, into one cohesive look

- Work with AI-generated source clips: select the cleanest usable frames, cut around artefacts, and know when a clip needs regenerating

- Deliver organised, export-ready files to platform spec, and help us build reusable templates as the format matures



What This Role Is Not



This is not a role for a generalist or long-form editor. Wedding, vlog, corporate, and talking-head YouTube editing is a different craft, and we're specifically after short-form, brand-led vertical work.



It's not for CapCut-and-auto-captions editors. We care about custom, on-brand typography and real sound design, not templated defaults.



And it's not for someone who needs constant hand-holding. You receive the brief, ask the right questions upfront, and deliver, with proactive communication if questions come up.



What We're Looking For



Required:



- A strong portfolio of published short-form vertical work (Reels / TikTok / Shorts) that shows real craft. Brand or product content preferred, not personal vlogs. We will be looking at it critically

- Expert-level in either After Effects or Premiere Pro, and strong in the other. After Effects capability matters, because our caption and title work lives there

- Motion graphics and kinetic typography. You can animate text in a brand typeface and make it feel designed

- Genuine sound-design instinct. Cutting music to the beat and making a drop land is non-negotiable, it's where a good reel becomes a great one

- Colour grading, the ability to take mismatched clips and unify them into a single, cohesive look

- Comfortable editing AI-generated footage and working around its quirks

- Reliable communication in English, written and spoken

- Able to work independently from a brief with minimal back-and-forth



Nice to have:



- Hands-on experience with AI video tools (Kling, Runway, or similar)

- A templated, systematic way of working. You document your process, because we intend to make our best formats repeatable

- Familiarity with Figma and working from brand deliverables

- Prior agency or brand content experience



How We Work Together



Every project starts with a briefing call where we walk you through the use case, goals, and brand direction. After the call, we provide written documentation and all relevant brand deliverables. From there, you own the edit. We expect proactive communication if questions come up. No silence until delivery.



Compensation



This starts as a gig engagement, paid hourly, based on experience and portfolio. We pay well for the right person. Strong collaborators will have the opportunity to move into a structured part-time role, and eventually a full-time position as the relationship grows.



How to Apply



Send us:



- Your portfolio, links to published, live short-form work only. No unlisted mockups or screenshots of editor views. We want to see what you've actually shipped

- A short introduction: your background, the types of projects you've worked on, the tools you're expert in, and your hourly rate expectation



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a paid test project, one full reel edited from a real brief, before we move forward. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.

title: UX/UI Web Designer
description:
*Web Designer (UX/UI) — Gig / Part-time / Full-time*

Boutique Branding Studio — Netherlands



---



*About the Role*



We're a boutique branding studio based in the Netherlands. We work at the intersection of brand strategy, identity, and digital execution. The websites we build are not afterthoughts to a brand project, they are the brand, made interactive.



We're looking for a Web Designer who leads with structure and ends with craft. Someone who opens a new project by thinking about pages, flows, and systems, not colours and typefaces. The visual execution matters enormously, but it comes last.



You'll join a small team on a gig basis, with a clear path to part-time and full-time for the right person. You'll own the design process from sitemap to hand-off, working alongside our brand leads and Webflow developer.



---



*Who You Are*



Before you are a designer, you are a systems thinker. You map information before you design screens. You wireframe to solve problems, not to sketch rough ideas. When you look at a website brief, your first instinct is to ask: what does this site need to do, how should it be structured, and how will someone move through it?



You understand the web as a medium, not a canvas. You think about scroll behaviour, states, responsiveness, and hierarchy the way a developer thinks about logic: it either works or it doesn't.



You're not a graphic designer who builds websites on the side. Web design is your specialism. It's where your thinking lives.



---



*What You'll Do*



— Translate briefs and brand strategy into sitemaps and content architecture before a single screen is designed

— Build wireframes that define structure, hierarchy, and user flow with enough detail that they could be critiqued and approved on their own

— Design full website concepts in Figma, desktop and mobile, using consistent components and a system-first approach

— Build and maintain design systems and component libraries that scale across pages and projects

— Hand off clean, structured Figma files to our Webflow developer with zero ambiguity

— Work closely with brand leads from briefing through to final design, contributing to conceptual direction where needed



---



*What We're Not Looking For*



A graphic designer who can also do web. Someone who jumps to visual design before the structure is solved. Someone who designs pages in isolation without thinking about the system they belong to. Someone who needs direction at every step.



If your portfolio is full of beautiful screens with no evidence of the thinking behind them, this is not the right role.



---



*What We're Looking For*



Required:

— 5+ years specialising in web design — not general graphic, brand, or print design

— A genuine process: sitemap ? wireframe ? visual design, every time

— Strong information architecture skills — you can define page structure, navigation logic, and content hierarchy from a brief

— Wireframes that stand on their own — detailed, annotated, and used as a real tool for alignment

— Expert Figma skills: components, auto layout, variants, design systems, developer hand-off

— A systems mindset — you think in reusable parts, not one-off pages

— Deep understanding of web UX: conversion logic, scroll behaviour, mobile-first thinking, interactive states

— Portfolio of live marketing and corporate websites that show process, not just output

— Clear, proactive communicator in English



Nice to have:

— Familiarity with Webflow, knowing how your designs will be built makes you a better designer

— Experience building or maintaining full design systems across multiple projects

— Conceptual contribution to brand and campaign work that feeds into web

— Micro-interaction or animation thinking at the wireframe stage



---



*How We Work Together*



A project starts with a briefing — sometimes strategic, sometimes a brand deep-dive, often both. From there, you lead: sitemap first, wireframes second, visual design third. You'll work closely with our brand leads and Webflow developer at each stage. Client communication stays with the studio. Your job is to design something that works and looks considered, then hand it off clearly.



We're a small team. We don't micromanage, and we don't chase. We expect you to ask the right questions early, raise blockers when they appear, and deliver work that doesn't need explaining.



---



*Compensation*



Hourly rate is based on experience and portfolio. We pay well for the right person.



This starts as a gig engagement. Strong collaborators will have the opportunity to move into a structured part-time role, and eventually a full-time position as the relationship grows.



---



*How to Apply*



Send us:



— Your portfolio — live websites only. We're not interested in Dribbble shots, unsolicited redesigns, or graphic design work. Show us websites you shipped.

— 2–3 case studies that walk us through your process: how you structured the site, what the wireframes looked like, how the final design connects back to the brief. The thinking matters as much as the output.

— A short introduction: who you are, what kinds of projects you've worked on, and your hourly rate.



*Applications without a process-driven case study will not be reviewed.*

Starcs Digital is looking for a hands-on B2B Lead Generation & Appointment Setting Specialist to help build a repeatable outbound sales pipeline.



This is not a general virtual assistant role. Your focus will be simple:



Find qualified prospects. Contact them. Call them. Follow up. Book qualified sales conversations.



You will work directly with the founder of Starcs Digital and focus initially on emerging U.S.-based businesses that may need marketing execution and customer-acquisition support.



What you will do:



Research and identify qualified prospects using Apollo, Google, TikTok Shop, online directories, and other sources

Identify founders, owners, CEOs, or relevant decision-makers

Build and manage targeted prospect lists in Apollo

Use Apollo to find and verify contact information and manage
 sequences

Make outbound cold calls to U.S.-based businesses

Ask basic qualification questions and identify relevant marketing needs

Follow up consistently by phone and

Handle basic objections professionally

Book qualified sales calls directly onto the founder's calendar

Keep outreach activity and prospect status updated in a tracker provided by Starcs



You are not responsible for closing sales. Your job is to create qualified opportunities.



Apollo experience is required. You should already know how to search and filter prospects, build lists, work with sequences, review replies, manage bounced contacts, and keep prospect data organized.



Strong spoken English is also essential. A significant part of the role involves calling U.S. business owners and decision-makers during U.S. business hours.



Requirements:



2+ years of B2B lead generation, appointment setting, SDR, or outbound sales experience

Hands-on Apollo.io experience

Strong spoken and written English

Comfortable making cold calls to U.S. businesses

Experience finding decision-makers and contact information

Cold
 experience

Strong follow-up habits

Comfortable handling basic objections

Organized, reliable, and able to work independently

Comfortable being measured against clear activity and appointment targets



Experience sourcing prospects through TikTok Shop, Google, or other nontraditional sources is helpful but not required.



Performance targets



We will provide the target customer profile, messaging, call framework, tracker, and ongoing feedback.



Your initial targets will be:



First 30 days: 10+ qualified sales calls booked

Days 31-60: 20+ qualified sales calls booked

Target show rate: 70%+



We will also track prospects sourced, calls attempted, decision-makers reached, replies, qualified conversations, meetings held, and clients acquired.



We want someone who pays attention to what is working and shares useful observations each week so we can continuously improve the process.



Schedule



20 hours per week.



You must be available for a meaningful portion of your working hours during U.S. Eastern Time business hours because outbound calling is a core responsibility.



Compensation



$5 USD/hour + performance bonuses



Additional incentives will be provided for qualified meetings and new clients generated through your prospecting.



$50 bonus for every new paying client acquired through your outreach.



This role has the opportunity to grow in hours and compensation as the outbound channel generates consistent revenue.



How to apply



Please include the following in your application:



How many years of outbound B2B sales or appointment-setting experience do you have?

Describe exactly how you have used Apollo.io in a previous role.

Approximately how many outbound calls are you comfortable making during a 4-hour shift?

What percentage of the appointments you booked in your most recent role typically showed up?

Tell me about a time you were given an ICP or target customer and had to find prospects yourself. Where did you find them?

Please include a short voice introduction so we can evaluate spoken English and phone communication.



Important: Start your application with the words “Apollo Ready” so we know you read the full job description.

title: Meta Ad Library Researcher (Winning Static Ads & Products)
description:
We are a direct-to-consumer beauty & skincare brand. We need a sharp researcher to spend time inside the Meta Ad Library every day, hunting for winning static (image) ads and the products behind them.



This is a research + logging role. You are our eyes in the market. You will NOT design, write copy, or launch anything. You find proven winners and document them cleanly so our team can act on them.



WHAT MAKES AN AD "WINNING"

The strongest signal is longevity + spend: ads that have been running for weeks or months, and advertisers running many variations of the same image. Long-running ads are almost always profitable ads. That's what we want you to catch.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Search the Meta Ad Library daily in the beauty / skincare / cosmetics niche

Focus on STATIC image ads (not video) — this is the whole point of the role

Identify ads that have been running a long time and/or are being run in high volume

For each winner, log it in our Google Sheet: screenshot, brand/page name, product, how long it's been running, the landing page/offer, and the angle (what problem it sells against)

Identify the actual product being sold and where it appears to be sourced

Only flag TOPICAL / cosmetic products (creams, serums, roll-ons, patches, tools). Skip anything ingested (pills, powders, drinks, supplements) — we don't sell those.

Hit a daily/weekly find target we agree on



WHO THIS IS FOR



You have a good eye for marketing — you can tell a real winner from a random ad

You are patient and thorough; you'll scroll for hours and stay organized

You log everything cleanly and consistently, no sloppy entries

You understand (or can quickly learn) how to read run-dates and variations in the Ad Library

Bonus: you've done ad research / "ad swiping" for a DTC or dropshipping brand before



TOOLS



Meta Ad Library (
/ads/library)

Google Sheets

A screenshot tool



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word CARIBOU so we know you read this fully. Applications without it are deleted.

Send us ONE example of a beauty/skincare image ad you found in the Ad Library that you'd flag as a winner — the page name and why you think it's winning.

Tell us if you've done ad research before, and for what kind of brand.



HOW WE HIRE

We start with one small paid test task: find and log 10 winning static ads to our format. If your finds and logging are good, we move to an ongoing part-time arrangement. Payment is per completed, approved deliverable.

title: HOA Manager
description:
The HOA Property Manager is responsible for the day?to?day operations, governance support, vendor oversight, and owner/resident experience across an assigned portfolio of homeowner associations. This role requires strong analytical ability, impeccable attention to detail, and exceptional written and verbal communication skills. The manager serves as the primary liaison among the Board of Directors, unit owners, residents, vendors, and internal teams (Maintenance and Finance), ensuring that association operations comply with governing documents, applicable laws, and company standards while meeting service-level and financial targets.



Key Outcomes (What Success Looks Like):



Accurate, timely Board packets and meeting facilitation with clear minutes and action logs

Portfolio-level adherence to budgets, assessments, and reserve funding plans in partnership with Finance HOA

Proactive maintenance planning and on-time completion of preventive and corrective work with Maintenance HOA

High owner/resident satisfaction, timely resolution of requests, and transparent communications

Clean annual audits, renewed insurance policies, and documented compliance with statutes and governing documents

Up-to-date task/project management in Asana and on-time delivery of recurring HOA cycles and filings



Key Responsibilities:

1) Board & Governance Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for Board members; prepare agendas, Board packets, and management reports for regular and special meetings.

Interpret and apply governing documents (CC&Rs, bylaws, rules) and relevant state statutes in daily operations; coordinate with counsel when required.

Facilitate annual meetings, elections, and owner notices in accordance with legal and governing document requirements.

2) Owner & Resident Relations

Maintain responsive, professional communication with trustees/Board, unit owners, and residents via
, phone, and portal.

Issue timely association-wide notices (policy changes, maintenance schedules, community events, compliance reminders).

Manage and resolve escalations, complaints, architectural review requests (ARC), violations, and hearings within established SLAs.

3) Financial Coordination & Reporting 

Support budget development, reserve study implementation, and monthly variance commentary; review financials for accuracy.

Monitor assessment billing, collections, payment plans, and delinquency follow-up in alignment with collection policies.

Review and approve invoices, code expenses to budgets, and validate vendor work completion prior to payment.

4) Maintenance, Projects & Vendor Management (with Maintenance HOA)

Translate Board priorities into annual maintenance calendars; schedule and track preventive maintenance and inspections.

Open, monitor, and close work orders; ensure scope, SLA, and quality standards are met; maintain accurate asset records.

Bid, negotiate, and manage vendor contracts (landscaping, janitorial, security, pools, roofing, elevators, etc.); perform periodic vendor reviews.

Coordinate capital improvement projects (RFPs, proposals, schedules, owner notifications, punch lists, closeout documents).

5) Information Management & Systems

Keep all HOA Asana projects/boards current with daily updates, dependencies, and follow-ups; maintain recurring tasks and automations.

Process resale and lender questionnaire packages accurately and within service timelines; maintain fee schedules.

Maintain organized digital records (governing docs, minutes, contracts, insurance, warranties, architectural files) in the association’s repository.

6) Team Leadership & Development

Train and onboard new APMs/PMs on processes, systems (Asana, accounting/portal), compliance, and customer service standards.

Promote a collaborative, service-oriented culture aligned with company values; escalate staffing/resource needs to the Unit Head.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

On-time completion rate for recurring HOA tasks and compliance filings

Work-order first-response and average time-to-close (by priority)

Delinquency rate and collections effectiveness; percent of assessments collected

Budget adherence (OPEX/CapEx) and variance accuracy; invoice cycle time

Owner/resident satisfaction score; complaint resolution time

Board satisfaction score (post-meeting surveys) and action-item closure rate

Qualifications:

3+ years of HOA/condo association management or related property management experience

Demonstrated proficiency with task/project management tools (Asana) and owner portals; strong Excel/Google Sheets skills

Exceptional communication (written and verbal), meeting facilitation, and stakeholder management

Strong analytical, organizational, and time-management skills; high attention to detail

Working knowledge of governing documents, meeting procedures, collections, elections, and common HOA statutes

title: Admin Assistant with Xero Bookkeeping Experience
description:
Hi! I’m Rona



I’m currently the Operations, Finance & HR Lead | Founder’s 2IC across Duke the Label and Velocity Digital Co, and I’m looking for a full-time Admin Assistant who will work directly under me.



One important requirement for this role is Xero experience, particularly with basic bookkeeping and reconciliations.



However, I want to make it clear that bookkeeping will not be the entirety of your role.



You’ll essentially be supporting me with the smaller day-to-day tasks that currently sit across my workload so I can spend more time focusing on higher-level finance, operations, HR, forecasting, investigations, and business management.



Your tasks may include things like:



• Assisting with Xero reconciliations and bookkeeping-related admin

• Updating spreadsheets, trackers, and internal records

• Following up on outstanding tasks or information

• Addressing straightforward concerns or coordinating them with the right person

• Scheduling meetings, calls, reminders, and recurring tasks

• Organising files, documents, and information

• Assisting with invoices, payments, and other finance admin

• Updating employee or contractor information

• Helping with onboarding and other HR-related admin

• Checking that tasks have been completed and following up where needed

• Researching information or finding solutions to operational concerns

• Preparing information I need for reports or decision-making

• General administrative and VA tasks that I delegate to you



The best way to describe the role is that you’ll be helping me take smaller day-to-day tasks off my plate.



One day, that might mean reconciling transactions in Xero. Another day, it could be updating a spreadsheet, scheduling something, following up with someone, checking an invoice, organising information, or helping me address an internal concern.



There will be variety, but these are tasks that currently sit within my own role. I’m simply starting to delegate the smaller ones so I can focus more of my time on higher-level responsibilities.



I’m not expecting you to come in and immediately take over entire areas of my role.



I’ll be assigning and overseeing your tasks, and I’m very willing to train the right person. As you become more familiar with both businesses and I become confident in your work, I’ll gradually be able to delegate more to you.



What I’m really looking for is someone I can eventually give a task to, explain what needs to happen, and trust them to run with it.



What I’m looking for:



• Must be available to work AU business hours: 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Brisbane time / 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM PH time

• Xero experience is required

• Strong attention to detail

• Organised and comfortable managing multiple tasks

• Fast learner

• Resourceful and proactive

• Comfortable researching and trying to find a solution before immediately asking for help

• Good written communication

• Reliable and accountable

• Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment

• Takes ownership of their work

• Comfortable with variety and wearing different hats



You don’t need to know everything.



I would much rather hire someone who learns quickly, listens carefully, asks the right questions, and genuinely wants to become dependable than someone who ticks every technical box but needs to be constantly followed up.



What’s included:



• $5 USD/hour

• Full-time role

• Salary progression based on performance

• 10 days paid vacation leave

• 5 days paid sick/emergency leave

• Paid Australian public holidays

• Bonus at the Founder’s discretion

• Hired directly by the company

• Long-term opportunity for the right person



You’ll also be joining an established Filipino team across different departments, so while you’ll be working directly under me, you won’t feel like you’re working completely on your own.



If you’re genuinely interested, please send the following through the OLJ inbox only:



A short written introduction about yourself

Your experience using Xero and what you’ve handled inside the platform

Other admin, finance, HR, operations, or VA tasks you’ve handled before

Your updated CV/resume

On a scale of 1–10, how interested are you in this role, and why? Please give me a genuine answer rather than what you think I want to hear.



From there, I’ll reach out to shortlisted applicants to arrange a call.

title: B2B Appointment Setter / Vending Location Acquisition – Australia
description:
Base Salary + Uncapped Commission | Work From Home – Philippines



We are a growing Australian vending and smart retail operator based in Sydney.



We are looking for an experienced B2B appointment setter / outbound salesperson whose job is simple:



Find us great locations for our vending machines and smart coolers.



This is not a general VA role and it is not customer service.



You will spend your day prospecting, calling,
ing, using LinkedIn, following up and speaking with Australian business decision-makers.



What You Will Do



* Research and build targeted prospect lists

* Make outbound B2B calls every day

* Prospect through LinkedIn and

* Reach decision-makers including Operations Managers, HR, Facility Managers, Office Managers, Business Owners and Site Managers

* Qualify locations against our criteria

* Book qualified site meetings for our Australian team

* Follow up prospects consistently until you receive a clear yes or no

* Maintain every prospect and activity in our CRM



We are targeting businesses such as:



* Warehouses and distribution centres

* Manufacturing facilities

* Large offices

* Gyms and fitness centres

* Hospitals and healthcare

* Schools and education

* Automotive businesses

* High-traffic workplaces and commercial facilities



What Are You Offering?



Modern vending machines and AI-powered smart coolers that can be supplied, installed, stocked, maintained and managed by us at no cost to qualifying locations.



You are not expected to close complicated sales.



Your objective is to:



Find the right site → reach the right person → create interest → qualify the opportunity → book the meeting.



Our Australian team takes over from there.



Who We Want



You MUST have previous experience in:



* B2B cold calling

* Appointment setting

* Lead generation or business development

* Speaking directly with business owners and decision-makers



You should also be:



* Highly confident speaking English

* Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

* Persistent without being aggressive

* Strong at objection handling

* Capable of researching your own prospects

* Experienced with LinkedIn prospecting and cold

* Comfortable working with a CRM

* Motivated by targets and commission



If most of your experience is inbound customer service or general VA work, this position is probably not for you.



Compensation



Base salary: PHP 35,000–45,000/month depending on experience



PLUS:



* Commission for qualified appointments

* Significant commission for locations successfully placed

* Monthly performance bonuses

* Uncapped earning potential



Strong performers should have the ability to earn significantly more than their base salary.



Working Hours



Full-time.



You will work primarily during Sydney, Australia business hours.



How We Measure Performance



We care about outcomes, not activity for the sake of activity.



We will measure:



* New businesses prospected

* Decision-makers reached

* Qualified conversations

* Follow-ups completed

* Qualified appointments held

* Locations approved

* Machines successfully installed



How to Apply



Do NOT send us a generic application.



Please send:



1. Your CV.

2. A 2-minute Loom video introducing yourself.

3. A short voice recording as though you were calling an Australian Operations Manager to discuss placing a vending machine at their workplace.

4. Answers to the following questions:



**A.** How many outbound B2B calls did you typically make each day in your previous role?



**B.** How many qualified appointments did you personally book per week?



**C.** Did you generate your own leads or were leads provided to you?



**D.** What industries have you cold-called?



**E.** What CRM, diallers, LinkedIn and
 prospecting tools have you used?



**F.** Tell us about one campaign where you were personally responsible for generating appointments from cold prospects.



**G.** What was your previous base salary and commission structure?



**H.** If we gave you the target of finding 10 large warehouses in Western Sydney that may want a vending service, explain exactly how you would find the decision-maker and approach them.



Applications that do not answer these questions and provide the requested recording will not be considered.



We are looking for two experienced, commercially minded outbound salespeople, not dozens of average applicants.

title: TikTok Ops Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced TikTok Operator to take ownership of our U.S. TikTok operations and develop the channel into a profitable and scalable source of revenue. This is a commercial e-commerce role, not simply a social media or content-posting position. You will oversee the full TikTok channel, including TikTok Shop, creators and affiliates, short form content, paid advertising, livestreaming, promotions, analytics, and profitability. We are looking for someone with proven experience launching TikTok operations from the ground up or significantly scaling an existing TikTok channel. The role will initially be hands-on, with the opportunity to build and manage a TikTok team as the channel grows. 





JOB SPECIFICATIONS



[TikTok Business & Profitability]

- Understands how to grow TikTok sales while protecting margin, not just chasing GMV

- Good with numbers — can tell what's working, what's not, and what to scale or stop



[TikTok Shop Operations]

- Knows how TikTok Shop works — listings, pricing, promos, bundles, discount codes, store health



[Creators & Affiliates]

- Experience finding, recruiting, and managing TikTok creators and affiliates



[Content, Advertising & Livestream]

- Can guide short-form content strategy based on what performs well

- Familiar with TikTok Ads/Spark Ads and livestream operations



[Analytics & Reporting]

- Comfortable pulling together weekly performance updates and explaining the "why" behind the numbers



[Systems & Team Building]

- Can build simple SOPs/processes so the work runs smoothly as the team grows

- Open to eventually helping hire and manage a small supporting team





DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run the TikTok channel and grow its sales for the U.S. market

- Manage the TikTok Shop — product listings, pricing, promos, and store health

- Find, recruit, and manage TikTok creators and affiliates to promote products

- Plan and guide short-form video content based on what performs well

- Handle or oversee TikTok ads and livestreams

- Give weekly updates on sales, ads, creators, and content performance

- Create simple processes so the work can run smoothly as the team grows

- Strong English communication skills, written and verbal

- Can work independently, solve problems, and take full ownership of results





NON-NEGOTIABLES



- Based within Luzon (Highly preferably within NCR)

- Proven experience launching, growing, or scaling TikTok operations for a brand, ideally in the U.S. market

- Strong track record of driving measurable sales growth and improving overall TikTok channel performance

- Strong understanding of the TikTok Shop ecosystem and its key sales/growth drivers





NICE TO HAVE



- Background in health, wellness, beauty, personal care, supplements, medical products, sports, or other regulated consumer categories

- Experience managing TikTok at significant sales/GMV scale, or across multiple brands/shops

- Experience building or leading a TikTok/e-commerce team, or managing large creator networks

- Direct experience working with TikTok account managers or platform reps

- Experience managing TikTok alongside Amazon or other major e-commerce channels

title: Video Editor / 2D Animator — Long-Form YouTube Anthology (Weekly)
description:
RATE / BUDGET (required field):

$500–800 USD per finished video

• First video: $700 (includes character rig + asset library build)

• Videos 2+: $550–700 (library reuse reduces per-video time)

• Paid test project: $50 for one 90-second segment



ABOUT THE PROJECT



We make long-form anthology videos about history's darkest, strangest corners — think Trust Me Bro, Chat History, Sideprojects. Every 22-minute video contains 12 self-contained stories, each one about 90 seconds, bound by a single premise. The scripts are written, researched, and source-verified. Voiceover is recorded. Your job is everything visual.



First video: "The Deadliest Job In Every Time Period" — twelve jobs across twelve eras, each one killing you in a different way.



THE VISUAL STYLE



2D animation, character-driven, deliberately simple. Thick black outlines, flat fills, expressive faces doing emotional work. Cut-out animation with rigged characters — not frame-by-frame, not photoreal, not AI-generated.



Real footage and archival stills carry the history — public-domain photographs, archival film, engravings, museum scans, maps. Roughly half the runtime lives here. The animation integrates with these photos (not pasted on top). Both layers feel like one show.



THE FORMAT REQUIREMENTS



•  21–23 minute runtime

•  12 items, ~90 seconds each

•  Hard cuts between items (no transitions, no "next up" cards)

•  Visual change every 3–6 seconds (never static)

•  Comic timing on the deflation beat (dry one-liner after escalation)

•  Escalation you can see visually (framing, cuts, colour, sound)

•  Sound design: ambience, SFX, music under the voice, no dead air



Each item follows this structure:

•  Name the thing (bare noun phrase)

• Establish the ordinary state

•  Introduce the deviation

•  Escalate 2–3 rungs

• Deliver the reveal

•  Dry closing beat (the joke)

•  Hard cut to next item



DELIVERABLES PER VIDEO



•  Final master: 1080p minimum (4K preferred), 16:9, H.264

•  Full sound mix: SFX, ambience, royalty-free music, VO levelled to -14 LUFS

•  3 vertical Shorts cuts (45–60s) pulled from strongest items

•  Source project file + character/asset library

• Two revision rounds included per video



WHAT YOU NEED



MUST HAVE:

• After Effects (rigging, cut-out animation, expressions)

• Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve

• Portfolio: minimum 60+ seconds of long-form animated work (not just shorts/TikToks)

• Ability to source, treat, and integrate archival material correctly

• Working English to read scripts and understand tone

• Reliable weekly turnaround: script + VO delivered Monday ? final cut Thursday



NICE TO HAVE:

• Illustrator or Procreate for original assets

• Experience on faceless/documentary YouTube channels

• Understanding of pacing and retention mechanics



IMPORTANT: PAID TEST REQUIRED



You will edit one 90-second segment from the real script first. This costs $50 and takes ~2 hours of work. This weeds out mismatches before we commit to video 1.



If the test lands, you move to the full first video at $700.



HOW TO APPLY



Send the following in your application message:



1. Link to ONE 60+ second animated piece with timestamp (e.g., "0:30–1:45")

   — Tell us what you did and why you're proud of it



2. Answer this question (2–3 sentences):

   "I have 12 items, each 90 seconds, hard cuts between them. Each item escalates then ends with a dry joke. I'm mixing archival photos with 2D animation so they look integrated, not pasted. What's the biggest technical challenge in pulling this off?"



3. Your rate per finished minute + your usual turnaround time for a 22-minute animated piece



4. Include the word "gong farmer" somewhere in your message

   (This tells us you actually read the job post.)



DO NOT APPLY IF:



•  Your portfolio is only shorts, TikToks, or Reels

•  You don't have After Effects

•  You're looking for hourly rates (this is per-video only)

•  You can't commit to a paid test project first

• You need turnarounds longer than 5 days



WHY THIS STRUCTURE MATTERS



The hard cuts, visual frequency, and deflation beats are the format. Generic editors will add transitions, slow down the pacing, or skip the comic timing. If you don't think in terms of retention, escalation, and deliberate composition, this isn't the fit.



TIMELINE



• Applications reviewed continuously

• Shortlisted candidates: invited to paid test within 2–3 days

• Test turnaround: 48 hours

• Video 1 starts: week you pass the test



LONG-TERM VISION



If videos 1–2 land well, we move to a monthly retainer (~$1,800+/month) for dedicated 1 video/week output. This is a trial period, but we're building for long-term partnership.

mbers get rewarded. But it starts with your application. Show us you actually read this.

title: Civil Estimator, Tendering and Costing (Remote, Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
CIVIL ESTIMATOR, TENDERING AND COSTING

Australian civil contractor | Full-time | Work from home in the Philippines | Long-term | Above-market pay



An established Victorian civil contractor is hiring a full-time Civil Estimator to price and prepare its tender and quote submissions. The work is earthworks, drainage, subdivision, utilities and concreting, mostly for local government and public sector buyers.



You will estimate in two directions. As prime contractor, the business tenders direct to councils and government. As subcontractor, it quotes civil packages to other builders. Both are civil. There is no building or fitout work in this role.



Long-term, full-time, working exclusively for one Australian business. Home-based in the Philippines, with no relocation, travel or overseas placement.





HAVE YOU APPLIED FOR A CIVIL ESTIMATOR ROLE WITH KASAMA BEFORE?



Please apply again. This is a new opening at a different company, not a repost of a role you have already seen. A previous application does not carry over and does not count against you. Send your current resume and answer the questions below.





THE ROLE



Government work is not won on price alone. The number matters, but so does the case around it: a method written for that job, the real risks named, evidence that you understand the site, and the right corporate information supplied. Evaluators notice the difference immediately.



So this is not only a take-off and pricing seat, and in fact on some jobs the take-offs are done for you. If you like building the sales argument as well as the number, you will do well here. If you would rather price the job and hand it to someone else to write up, this is not the role for you.



The business sees more opportunities than it can currently answer. Your job is to lift the number of submissions going out while improving their quality and the judgement behind which ones are worth chasing.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Work with the team to review, shortlist and select the tenders worth chasing.

- Read the tender documents, drawings and specifications. Identify what is in, what is out, and what needs a question lodged before pricing.

- Price the work: confirm supplied quantities or take them off yourself, then build the estimate across labour, plant, materials and subcontractors.

- Source and chase supplier and subcontractor quotes, post civil packages on Estimate One, quote to builders where the business is bidding as subcontractor, and build the relationships that make the next quote easier to get. Log every quote with the item, supplier and date so pricing is reused rather than chased twice.

- Set the questions to be answered on site, brief whoever attends, and write what comes back into the submission.

- Build and lodge the submission: a project-specific methodology, a risk register naming the real risks such as ground conditions, long-lead items and plant access, clear assumptions and exclusions, an MS Project programme with a critical path, accurate returnable schedules, and the corporate documents the buyer asked for. Then handle post-tender questions.





THE SUPPORT YOU GET



You will have a dedicated manager whose job is to make you successful. That means proper onboarding, access to the information, software and people you need, workflows and templates designed together with you, and problems cleared out of your way.



Your work is reviewed before anything is lodged. Accuracy is still yours to own.





WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Demonstrated civil estimating experience: earthworks, drainage, subdivision, roadworks, utilities or similar. This is the one requirement we cannot train around, and applications without it will not be progressed.

- Confident reading civil drawings and specifications and producing accurate quantity take-offs.

- Fluent in digital take-off and estimating software. Tell us what you use. We are not tied to a particular package.

- Strong written and spoken English, and a professional manner on camera. You will write documents that Australian government evaluators read and score, and you will be on phone and video calls with the team and with suppliers.

- Working knowledge of MS Project, or the ability to get there quickly.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets.

- Organised and deadline-driven, able to run several live submissions at once without dropping detail.

- Reliable internet and a professional home working setup.

- Able to work a day shift aligned to Melbourne business hours, which means an early start in the Philippines.





NICE TO HAVE



- Australian civil project experience, or familiarity with Australian standards and tender portals.

- Local government or council tendering experience.

- Experience quoting civil packages to head contractors as well as tendering direct.

- A working sense of Australian supplier and subcontractor pricing.

- Drafting or CAD experience.

- Experience in improving internal processes and systems for tendering and estimating.





WHAT IS ON OFFER



- Above-market monthly pay, negotiable based on experience.

- Long-term, stable, full-time work.

- Melbourne business hours, Monday to Friday.

- Software, licences and tender portal access provided.

- A dedicated manager invested in your success.

- Real scope to shape how the estimating and tendering process is built.





HOW TO APPLY



Send your current resume and answer all eight questions below. If you have one, include a sanitised sample of your work with client details removed. A methodology or risk register you wrote yourself tells us more than a priced spreadsheet.



1. Your civil estimating background: years, project types, typical value ranges, and whether you tender as prime contractor, quote as a subcontractor, or both.



2. Walk us through one civil submission end to end: the project, roughly what it was worth, what you were responsible for, what software you used, and whether it won.



3. Do you write the methodology and risk register yourself, or does someone else do that part? If you write them, how do you approach it?



4. How do you source and compare supplier and subcontractor pricing, and what do you do when someone will not come back to you?



5. Which software do you use in your estimating (take-offs, project plans, pricing, documents and so on)?



6. Do you have Australian project experience? Please describe.



7. Have you worked on setting up or improving tendering systems and workflows? Please describe.



8. Your expected monthly salary in PHP, earliest start date and notice period, and confirmation you can work a day shift aligned to Melbourne business hours. Tell us if you have worked remotely for an overseas client before.



Shortlisted candidates go to a short video interview and a brief estimating exercise.

title: Instagram DM Sales Rep (Sell by Chat) - Own the Whole Process
description:
JOB TITLE

Instagram DM Sales Closer (3+ Years) - Own Our Entire DM Sales Channel



TYPE OF WORK

Part time to start (15 hrs/week), moving to full time



SALARY

PHP 450 to 600 per hour depending on what you can prove, plus PHP 2,000 commission for every new member you sign, uncapped



HOURS

5 days a week inside 9:00am to 5:00pm Manila time (times are negotiable)





=====================================



READ THIS PART FIRST



This is not a message answering job and it is not a virtual assistant job. We are handing one person our entire Instagram sales channel and asking them to run it.



You will report to the founder, but will have complete ownership of the sales system. If you need to be told what to do each day, this role will not work for you and you should not apply.



We want someone who has done this for at least three years, who has their own opinions about what works, and who has proven results.





ABOUT US



We are a sports nutrition coaching business based in Sydney, Australia. We work with fighters. MMA, boxing, BJJ, judo, wrestling. Our job is to get them to their fight weight without wrecking their performance on fight night.



We run Instagram content and paid ads and we get a steady flow of new leads every week. Right now the founder handles those conversations between coaching calls, which means good leads go cold and most never get followed up.





HOW THE ROLE GROWS



You start part time on inbound only. Roughly the first 4 to 8 weeks, 15 hours a week. You learn our voice, our offer and our fighters, and you work only the leads who come to us: our free making weight calculator, our free ebook, ad leads in Leads Center, story replies and comment to DM. We start you here because we want you closing well before we scale your volume.



Once your numbers hold for two straight weeks, you move to full time and add outbound. That means 40 hours a week, keeping all the inbound, and going out to find fighters who already have a competition booked instead of waiting for them to find us. Hashtags, event pages, fight cards, gym accounts, our past clients, our old lead list and our workshop buyers.



Outbound is where this role gets interesting, because it is the half you get to design. We will tell you what our best clients look like. How you go and find more of them is your call.



The move to full time is based on your numbers, not on time served. We expect it to happen. If it does not, we hired the wrong person.





WHAT YOU OWN



Everything between a stranger seeing our content and a fighter paying us.



- Opening conversations, personalised to the human on the other end, never copy paste

- Qualifying properly, and letting go of the ones we cannot help quickly and politely

- Presenting the offer, handling objections, closing the sale

- Following up on a set cadence, not whenever you remember

- Reactivating our past clients and old leads

- Building and running the outbound side once you are full time

- Logging every conversation in the CRM with stage and outcome

- Owning the numbers, reporting them weekly, and telling us what the objections are saying about our offer and our ads



You will be given a proven script, an offer document, an objection bank and a library of real conversations that have already turned into sales. You are not starting from zero. But we expect you to improve on all of it. If our script is losing people at a certain point, we want you to tell us and rewrite it, not run it silently for six months.





WHAT YOU ARE NOT



You are not the coach. You will never give nutrition advice, weight cutting advice, training advice or anything medical. If someone asks a coaching question you get them excited about speaking to the coach and pass it up.



Any message about a weight cut in progress, an injury or anything clinical gets escalated to the founder straight away. We are a health business and this rule is not negotiable.





THE NUMBERS YOU WILL BE HELD TO



You see your own scoreboard and so do we. We review it every week.



While you are on inbound:

- First reply to a new lead: within 15 minutes during your shift

- New leads left untouched at end of shift: zero

- Opener to reply rate: 35% or better

- Reply to qualified conversation: 40% or better

- Qualified to offer presented: 70% or better

- Offer presented to sale: 30% or better

- Follow up compliance: 100% of open threads touched on cadence

- Minimum 10 sign ups per month (20k commission bonus per month)

- Conversations logged in CRM: 100%



Once you add outbound:

- New outbound conversations opened per day: 30 to 50

- Outbound targets who already have a competition booked: 70% or better



Inbound and outbound are tracked separately. They convert very differently and we do not want them blended.



For your first 30 days we hold you to the process and the volume, not the sales. After that, conversion is the job.





YOU WILL BE GREAT AT THIS IF



- You have 3+ years selling by chat and can show us the receipts, not just describe them

- You have owned a sales channel before, not just executed someone else's steps

- You are comfortable being ignored seven times out of ten and still showing up the next day

- You write like a real person. Short messages, real questions, no essays, no corporate tone, no obvious templates

- You already track your own numbers because you want to beat them

- You bring solutions. When something is broken you arrive with two options and a recommendation

- You can be trusted with our Instagram account and our brand voice without supervision





YOU WILL HATE THIS ROLE IF



- You want a manager checking in on you three times a day

- You want a fixed script you never have to think about

- You are uncomfortable telling the founder he is wrong about something

- You have only ever done customer support or admin work in an inbox





TOOLS



Meta Business Suite and Leads Center, ManyChat, Google Sheets. You must have used Business Suite and Leads Center before. 





WHAT WE OFFER



- PHP 450 to 600 per hour based on what you can show us you have done

- PHP 2,000 for every new member you sign, uncapped, from day one

- A 30 day ramp where we pay commission at target while you learn, so you are not out of pocket during training

- A clear, numbers based path from 20 hours to 40 hours, and we want you to get there fast

- A yearly budget for a sales course of your choosing

- Long term work with one client, direct access to the founder, and no layers in between

- Real room to grow. As this scales, the person in this seat runs the sales side and hires the next rep





HOW TO APPLY



Read this carefully. We reject anyone who misses a step, because following instructions is the first test of the job.



Start your message with the word CORNERMAN so we know you read the whole post.



Then send us:



1. A voice note, 60 to 90 seconds. Tell us why you would be good at this, and walk us through one sale you made entirely by chat, start to finish.



2. Two screenshots of real DM conversations you ran end to end. Cover the names. We want to see how you actually write.



3. Your numbers. Conversations per day, reply rate, close rate, and how you tracked them. If you do not have real numbers, say so honestly rather than inventing them.



4. A three message opener for this lead: a 24 year old amateur MMA fighter followed us after watching a reel and downloaded our free making weight calculator. He has not replied to anything yet. Write the exact first three messages you would send him.



5. One thing you would want to change or test in a DM funnel like ours in your first month, and why. Two or three sentences is plenty. This is the question we care most about.



6. Your available start date.



We want to move fast. Shortlisted applicants get a paid test project and then an interview with the founder. We want someone in the seat within two weeks.

title: AI Content Creator & Social Media Manager – Virtual Influencer
description:

Responsibilities



* Create high-quality images and short-form videos featuring a consistent AI-generated virtual influencer

* Produce content for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts

* Research current trends, viral formats, sounds and content opportunities

* Generate creative content ideas, hooks and captions

* Edit engaging short-form videos

* Schedule and publish content consistently

* Maintain the same appearance, personality and visual identity of the AI influencer across content

* Monitor account performance and identify which content performs best

* Assist with community engagement and basic comment/DM management

* Research suitable affiliate products and content opportunities

* Help incorporate affiliate products naturally into content

* Research potential brands for collaborations and sponsorships

* Assist with brand outreach as the account grows

* Provide simple weekly updates on content performance, growth and recommendations



Ideal Candidate



You should have experience with some combination of:



* AI image generation

* AI video generation

* AI avatars / virtual influencers

* ChatGPT or similar AI tools

* CapCut or similar video-editing software

* Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts

* Social media management

* Short-form content creation

* Trend research



Experience specifically creating AI influencers is highly desirable but not essential if you are an excellent short-form content creator who is comfortable learning new AI tools.



What We’re Looking For



We want someone who is:



* Creative and proactive

* Reliable and organised

* Comfortable working independently

* Able to follow detailed brand guidelines

* Interested in AI and emerging content trends

* Focused on growth and performance, not simply posting content

* Able to maintain consistency in an AI character’s appearance and personality



This is initially a part-time position, with the opportunity to expand the role as the virtual influencer grows.



To Apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Examples of social media content or accounts you have worked on.

4. The AI tools and editing software you currently use.

5. Your experience with TikTok, Instagram Reels and/or YouTube Shorts.

6. Your availability and preferred working hours.



Please start your application with the words “VIRTUAL CREATOR” so we know you have read the full job description.



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a small paid trial task before a long-term hire is made.

title: Australian Bookkeeper (Xero Specialist)
description:
About the Role



We're looking for a highly experienced and confident Bookkeeper with strong knowledge of Australian bookkeeping, payroll, and tax requirements. This is a hands-on role with real ownership — we need someone who can take charge of day-to-day bookkeeping and reduce our reliance on our accountant for routine matters.



The ideal candidate has previously worked with Australian businesses and has a solid understanding of Australian GST, BAS, PAYG withholding, superannuation, and payroll compliance. Experience with motor vehicle transactions and FBT is highly regarded.



Work Structure & Requirements



Location: Remote / Virtual (Philippines-based preferred)

Schedule: Part-time (1–2 days per week)

Time Zone: AWST (Perth, Western Australia) business hours preferred

Compensation: $8 USD per hour, depending on experience



Key Responsibilities



1. Day-to-Day Bookkeeping



Perform daily transaction coding and reconciliations in Xero

Correct or reallocate incorrectly coded transactions

Maintain accurate financial records and identify missing information

Record vehicle purchases, sales, insurance adjustments, refunds, and other account corrections



2. Accounts Payable & Receivable



Manage accounts payable and receivable accurately and on time

Monitor outstanding balances and follow up as needed



3. Payroll & Compliance



Set up and manage Australian employee and contractor payroll in Xero

Process regular and unscheduled pay runs

Handle superannuation processing and corrections

Manage STP reporting and year-end finalisation

Ensure PAYG withholding is correctly applied and reported



4. GST & BAS



Apply correct GST coding across transactions

Prepare BAS for review and processing



5. Accountant Liaison



Liaise with our Australian accountant when formal tax advice or lodgement is required

Ensure all records are accurate and complete ahead of accountant handoffs



Required Skills & Experience



Xero: High-level, hands-on Xero experience is essential — this is non-negotiable

Australian Market: Strong knowledge of Australian GST, BAS, PAYG withholding, superannuation, and payroll compliance; prior experience working with Australian businesses is required

Payroll: Confident with employee and contractor setup, pay runs, STP, and super processing

Motor Vehicle Transactions: Experience recording vehicle purchases, sales, and related adjustments is highly regarded; understanding of FBT is a plus

Profile: Confident, detail-oriented, and able to work independently with minimal oversight — someone who takes ownership rather than waiting to be directed



To Apply

Kindly send your resume and introduction video

title: Retail Account Executive
description:
About the Role



We're looking for a hands-on Retail Account Executive to manage the day-to-day commercial execution of our retail business and support the continued expansion of our brands across key US retailers. This role is highly operational and retailer-facing, working closely with our CEO, Finance, Marketing, and Product teams to ensure strong execution across existing accounts as well as new retail opportunities.



Work Structure & Requirements



Location: Remote / Virtual

Schedule: EST, 40 hours per week



Key Responsibilities



1. Retailer Outreach & Business Development



Identify and approach relevant retail partners and buyers

Conduct ongoing outreach to new and existing retail contacts and maintain momentum with prospective partners

Prepare retailer-specific presentations, line reviews, proposals, and assortment recommendations

Coordinate samples, product information, and other materials required by retailers

Maintain an active pipeline of retail opportunities and next steps



2. Key Account Management



Manage day-to-day communication with retail buyers and account teams

Serve as the main operational point of contact for assigned retail accounts

Coordinate and respond to retailer requests across assortments, pricing, promotions, markdowns, forecasts, purchase orders, planograms, item setup, and launch timing

Proactively follow up on open topics and ensure deadlines are met



3. Retail Meetings & Presentations



Prepare and lead retailer meetings, line reviews, and business reviews

Develop and adapt retailer presentations using existing company materials

Coordinate relevant sales data, product information, pricing, and marketing plans ahead of meetings

Manage follow-up actions, meeting recaps, and next steps



4. New Product & Retail Launch Execution



Coordinate new product introductions with Product, Marketing, Operations, and Finance

Ensure retailers receive required product information, images, samples, pricing, and launch materials on time

Track launch timelines, retailer deadlines, and item setup requirements

Follow up internally to ensure agreed launch dates and commitments can be met



5. Promotions & Commercial Execution



Coordinate retailer promotional requests and annual promotional calendars

Work with Finance to evaluate promotional economics, pricing, and retailer deductions

Track agreed promotions, discounts, markdowns, and commercial commitments

Support post-promotion reviews and assess incremental sales generated



6. Reporting & Sales Administration



Maintain clear account status and opportunity tracking

Provide regular updates on retailer conversations, open actions, and upcoming deadlines

Track sell-in, orders, forecasts, and launch opportunities

Flag risks or commercial issues early to management



Required Skills & Experience



Experience: Retail sales, key account management, or business development experience — ideally within Beauty, Personal Care, or Consumer Goods

Retailers: Strong understanding of working with major US retailers

Commercial Acumen: Comfortable working with pricing, margins, promotions, and deductions

Communication: Strong written and verbal English; able to prepare compelling retailer presentations and sales materials

Competencies: Highly organized, proactive, execution-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple retailer conversations simultaneously

Profile: Comfortable working in a fast-moving entrepreneurial environment and coordinating effectively across Product, Marketing, Finance, and Operations



Note: This is an operational sales and account management role. Major strategic retailer negotiations and company-wide commercial decisions remain with senior management.



To Apply

Kindly send your resume and introduction video

title: Full-Time WFH Client Success Manager — $2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

title: Finance Manager / Controller – US Company
description:
# Finance Manager / Controller – US Company



**Part-Time | 20 Hours/Week | Remote | Philippines**



### We are NOT looking for a bookkeeper.



We are looking for a **Finance Manager / Controller-level professional** who can own the entire financial picture of our business and tell us **what the numbers mean, what is changing, and what we should be concerned about.**



I want someone who has already **run finance for a US-based company** and understands what good financial management looks like in a US small-business environment.



If your experience is primarily recording transactions, reconciling accounts, and producing reports based on someone else's instructions, this is **not the role for you.**



If you can look at our numbers and say, **"Here's what is happening, here's why it is happening, and here's what we need to do about it,"** we want to hear from you.



## The Profile We're Looking For



You should have:



* Philippine CPA **OR** an accounting/finance degree with **6+ years of finance leadership experience**

* Direct experience working with **US-based companies**

* Strong understanding of **US small-business accounting practices**

* Deep expertise in **QuickBooks Online (QBO)**

* Experience cleaning up, restructuring, or migrating **messy books**

* Proven ability to build a **cash-flow forecast from scratch**

* Strong understanding of cash management, profitability, margins, AR/AP, and financial controls

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Comfortable getting on a call and **walking the business owner through the numbers**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

* The confidence to proactively raise financial concerns instead of waiting to be asked



## What You Will Own



### 1. QuickBooks Online – Full Ownership



You will be responsible for:



* Account reconciliation

* Proper categorization

* Chart of accounts integrity

* Month-end close

* Accurate and timely financial statements

* Identifying and correcting discrepancies

* Keeping the books clean and decision-ready



You should be able to **take ownership of QBO without needing someone to constantly tell you what to do.**



### 2. AR & AP Management



You will oversee:



* Accounts receivable

* Outstanding invoices and collections

* Accounts payable

* Payment scheduling

* Vendor management

* Cash requirements and upcoming obligations



### 3. Profit First



You will manage and maintain our **Profit First allocation structure**, ensuring allocations are accurate and consistently followed.



### 4. Daily Cash Snapshot



Every morning, you will provide a simple **cash-on-hand snapshot** showing where we stand financially.



The goal is to know our cash position **before** we make decisions—not after.



### 5. 13-Week Rolling Cash Forecast



You will build and maintain a **weekly 13-week rolling cash-flow forecast.**



This isn't a template-filling exercise.



You should be able to explain:



* What changed from last week

* Why it changed

* What upcoming cash pressures we should expect

* What assumptions are driving the forecast

* Where we may have a cash problem before it happens

* What actions management should consider



### 6. Monthly Financial Review



You will participate in a monthly financial review and walk us through:



* P&L

* Revenue trends

* Gross margins

* Margin by service line

* Operating expenses

* Cash position

* AR/AP

* Variances

* Profitability

* Where money is leaking

* What deserves management's attention



**We don't just want reports. We want interpretation.**



### 7. Proactive Financial Management



This is extremely important.



**I want to hear about a problem from you before I see it in the bank balance.**



If margins are declining, tell me.



If expenses are creeping up, tell me.



If cash flow is going to tighten three weeks from now, tell me.



If a service line isn't profitable, tell me.



If something doesn't look right, investigate it and bring it to my attention.



## The Bar



Here's a simple test for whether you're the level we're looking for:



**If we show you a job we quoted, can you tell us whether we actually made money on it?**



Not just:



> "You spent $X."



We want:



> "Based on the revenue, labor, materials, overhead allocation, and other costs, this job produced approximately X% margin, and here's what affected profitability."



You should be able to connect the accounting data to **actual business decisions.**



## Banking & Financial Controls



You will have appropriate access to execute **recurring and pre-approved payments within an established spending ceiling.**



Anything new or above the approved ceiling will require owner approval through the banking app.



**Vendor bank-detail changes must always be independently confirmed directly with the owner.**



These controls are non-negotiable and should be completely normal to someone operating at a Controller/Finance Manager level.



## Schedule



* **20 hours per week to start**

* Remote

* Flexible schedule, but you must be available for scheduled financial review calls

* Opportunity to increase hours and responsibility as the company grows



## This Role Is NOT For You If...



* You primarily consider yourself a bookkeeper

* You need detailed instructions for every task

* You only reconcile accounts and enter transactions

* You have never built a cash-flow forecast

* You have no experience working with US businesses

* You are uncomfortable explaining financial results verbally

* You wait for the owner to discover problems

* You cannot explain why profitability or cash flow is changing

* Your experience is limited to data entry and transaction processing



## This Role IS For You If...



You think like a **Controller/CFO**, even if your official title wasn't Controller or CFO.



You naturally ask:



**"What do the numbers tell us?"**



**"Why did this change?"**



**"What happens to cash over the next 13 weeks?"**



**"Where are we making money?"**



**"Where are we losing money?"**



**"What should the owner know right now?"**



If that sounds like you, **we want to hear from you.**



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your updated resume

2. Your current hourly rate

3. Your desired hourly rate

4. Your availability in hours/week

5. Your experience working with US-based companies

6. Your QuickBooks Online experience

7. An example of a **messy QBO cleanup or financial cleanup project** you personally handled

9. Tell us about a time you identified a financial problem **before the business owner noticed it**

10. Briefly explain how you would determine whether a **specific job/project was actually profitable**



### Important



Please do not send a generic application.



We are specifically looking for someone who can **own finance, understand the numbers, communicate clearly, and proactively help run the business.**



If you're genuinely operating at the **Finance Manager / Controller level**, we would love to hear from you.
