title: Social Media Copywriter & Content Research Specialist (AI Creator Brand)
description:
Summary

Social Media Copywriter & Content Research Specialist (AI Creator Brand)



We’re looking for an elite social media copywriter and content strategist who understands what makes people stop scrolling, watch, engage, and buy. Social media experience is a Must



This is not a prompt engineering role. We’re not looking for someone who copies ChatGPT or Claude outputs. We’re looking for someone who can think creatively, develop original concepts, and use AI to accelerate execution—not replace strategic thinking.



You’ll be responsible for creating high-converting content for AI influencer-style brands across Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.



What You’ll Do



* Research viral content daily across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.

* Stay ahead of emerging trends before they become saturated.

* Reverse engineer high-performing creators and understand why their content works.

* Write compelling hooks that maximize retention in the first few seconds.

* Write engaging short-form video scripts.

* Create captions that drive engagement, shares, saves, and conversions.

* Develop storytelling frameworks that build trust and authority.

* Apply buyer psychology and consumer behavior to create content that influences purchasing decisions.

* Create educational, authority-building, entertainment, and sales-focused content.

* Reframe winning ideas into original content for our brands.

* Build repeatable content series instead of one-off posts.

* Collaborate with our creative team to ensure messaging aligns with visuals and brand voice.



Requirements



* Expert knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.

* Exceptional written and spoken English.

* Outstanding copywriting skills.

* Deep understanding of:

    * Hook writing

    * Script writing

    * Storytelling

    * Consumer psychology

    * Buyer psychology

    * Sales psychology

    * Attention economics

    * Calls-to-action that convert

* Understand what drives engagement, watch time, shares, saves, and sales.

* Able to write naturally for AI influencer and creator-style brands.

* Can consistently generate original ideas without relying on AI to do the thinking.

* Strong research skills with the ability to identify trends before they become mainstream.

* Knows how to repurpose and reframe successful content into something unique.

* Highly organized with excellent attention to detail.

* Self-motivated and able to work independently.

* Comfortable receiving feedback and iterating quickly.



What We’re NOT Looking For



* Someone who simply prompts Claude or ChatGPT and copies the output.

* Generic copywriters with little understanding of social media.

* Writers who rely on AI to do all the thinking.

* People who chase trends without understanding strategy.

* Anyone with weak written or spoken English.



Bonus Skills



* Experience growing creator or business accounts.

* Proven examples of high-performing social media content.

* Experience writing for coaching, education, SaaS, AI, or digital products.

* Understanding of AI influencers and faceless content brands.

* Familiarity with social media analytics, retention metrics, watch time, CTR, and conversion optimization.

* Experience A/B testing hooks, captions, scripts, and messaging.



To Apply



Resumes are not required. We’re far more interested in your ability than your employment history.



Please include:



* Examples of your best hooks, captions, and scripts.

* Links to any social media accounts you’ve helped grow (if applicable).

* Examples of content you’re most proud of.

* A brief explanation of how you research trends and identify viral opportunities.

* Tell us what you believe separates content that gets views from content that generates sales.



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a small non paid test assignment to evaluate your content research, copywriting, hook writing, scripting, and creative thinking. We hire based on skill—not résumés.



If you’re someone who understands the psychology behind viral content, can consistently produce original ideas, and knows how to turn attention into revenue, we’d love to hear from you.

description:

We create unique plush products in collaboration with influencers, fandoms, and companies — and we are looking for a Research Specialist to help us find the best potential partners.





========================================

ROLE OVERVIEW

========================================



Your main task is to research and identify high-quality leads (potential partners) who would be a great fit for custom plush toy collaborations.



You will explore the internet, find promising creators/brands, and gather the most important information about them.





========================================

RESPONSIBILITIES

========================================

- YouTubers, Twitch streamers, TikTok creators

- Bands and musicians

- Online communities and fandoms

- Video game developers

- Brands and companies



• Collect and organize key information:



- Contact details 
, social media, websites)

- Audience size and engagement

- Niche relevance and brand fit

- Best way to contact (manager,
, DMs, etc.)



• Continuously improve research quality and find better opportunities





========================================

IMPORTANT: UNDERSTANDING WHAT MAKES A GOOD LEAD

========================================



We are NOT simply looking for creators with large audiences.



We are specifically looking for creators, brands, games, mascots, characters, or communities that can realistically be turned into strong plush products that fans would actually want to buy.



A good lead usually has:



- Recognizable characters, mascots, avatars, creatures, or visual identities

- Strong emotional connection between audience and character

- 
able, cute, funny, iconic, or collectible visual elements

- Existing fandom culture around specific characters or designs



Examples of weak leads:



- Generic beauty influencers with no recognizable mascot/character

- Creators whose content is only their real-life personality without visual branding

- Random large gaming communities without a clear character or mascot



Examples of strong leads:



- Creators with animated personas, mascots, or lore

- Games with recognizable creatures or characters

- Communities built around iconic designs or 
s

- Brands with mascots or collectible-style aesthetics



The most important question is:



“Can this realistically become a plush toy that fans would immediately recognize and want to collect?”





========================================

REQUIREMENTS

========================================



• Good English skills

• Good internet research skills

• Good understanding of social media platforms (YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, Instagram, etc.)

• Ability to understand niche communities and fanbases

• Ability to identify trends and promising creators





========================================

WORKING HOURS

========================================



• 3 hours per day

• Flexible schedule (please include your availability)





========================================

HOW TO APPLY

========================================



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your relevant experience

3. Your
 and other contact information



5. REQUIRED: Include 3 sample leads you personally researched.



For EACH sample lead, you MUST include:



- Who the creator/brand/community is

- Links/socials

- Why you believe they are a strong fit for plush merchandise

- WHAT specifically could be turned into a plush product

- Why fans would likely buy it



Very important:



Answers like “they have a big community” or “they are popular in gaming” are NOT enough.



We want to see clear thinking about the actual plush potential.



Good applications explain things like:



- Specific characters or mascots

- 
s, creatures, avatars, or visual branding

- Emotional attachment within the fandom

- Why the design would work physically as a plush

title: App Developer Needed – Lovable/Supabase Family Rewards App
description:
Project-based initially, with the opportunity for ongoing part-time development and maintenance.



About Us



The Fun4Hire Network is an established UK family entertainment business offering inflatables, party equipment, Play Centres, Party Pods, giveaways and entertainment packages.



We are also developing The Fun Hub Rewards Club—a growing membership and rewards platform connecting local families with our own events, equipment and offers from trusted partner businesses.



Our long-term aim is to make The Fun Hub the leading app for families looking to discover, book, save money on and win the best local family entertainment.



We are looking for a talented and reliable developer to help us build the first version of The Fun Hub app.



The Project



We want to create a professional, exciting and easy-to-use mobile app using:



* Lovable or a similar AI-assisted platform

* Supabase or Lovable Cloud or similar

* React or another suitable modern framework

* GitHub for code ownership and version control

* A Progressive Web App initially

* Capacitor or a similar solution for Apple and Android later



The first version should be a mobile-first web app that users can access through a link and save to their phone.



Once the concept has been tested successfully, we would like to release it through the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.



Important: Existing Equipment-Hire System



We already have a working website and specialist booking system for complex equipment hires.



The new app must not replace or initially integrate with this booking system.



The app will display attractive equipment-hire categories such as inflatables, silent discos, arcade games and party packages. When a member wants to book, the app will simply open the relevant page on our existing website.



The initial MVP should therefore remain focused, affordable and achievable.



Main App Features



Member Registration



* Free Fun Hub membership

* Paid Fun Hub Plus+ membership

*
 or mobile registration

* Secure login and password recovery

* Digital membership card

* Membership status

* User profile and communication preferences



Member Data and Personalisation



With the member’s permission, we would like to capture:



* Name

*
 address

* Mobile number

* Postcode/location

* Children’s age brackets

* Family interests

* Preferred activities

* Preferred travel distance

* Notification and marketing consent



This information will eventually allow us to show relevant events and offers based on location, ages and interests.



Personalised Home Screen



The home screen should feature:



* What’s on this weekend

* Recommended activities

* Nearby events

* Fun Hub Play Centres

* Party Pods

* Current giveaways

* Member offers

* Fun Hub Plus+ benefits

* Party and equipment-hire categories



Events and Play Centres



* Upcoming event listings

* Event images and videos

* Dates, times and locations

* Member and non-member prices

* Plus+ benefits

* Availability information

* Directions and venue information

* Book-now links



Initially, booking buttons can open our existing website checkout. A separate in-app ticketing system is not essential for the first version.



Party Pods and Check-Ins



Members should be able to:



* Find nearby Party Pods

* View opening hours and venue details

* Get directions

* Scan a venue-specific QR code

* Confirm their membership

* Record their visit

* Earn a check-in reward



We would also like QR check-ins at our Play Centres and selected partner venues.



The administration dashboard should record:



* Member checked in

* Venue

* Date and time

* Membership level

* New or returning visitor

* Number of children, where requested



Partner Offers



* Partner business profiles

* Member-only discounts

* Offer categories

* Location filtering

* Discount-code reveal

* Trackable partner links

* In-person offer activation

* Offer expiry dates and terms

* Views, clicks, claims and check-ins where possible



Different offers may use different redemption methods. Some will use codes, some will link to partner websites, and others will be claimed by showing the member’s app screen.



Giveaways



* Current giveaways

* Closing dates

* Simple entry process

* Automatic member entries

* Plus+-only giveaways

* Referral and check-in bonus entries

* Winner announcements

* Basic protection against duplicate entries



Referrals and Rewards



Every member should receive a unique referral link or QR code.



The app should track:



* Successful referrals

* Referral rewards

* Giveaway entries earned

* Check-in rewards

* Progress towards the next reward

* Weekly or monthly referral rankings



The Fun Hub Plus+



The app should support a paid membership tier with benefits such as:



* Priority event access

* Exclusive offers

* Additional giveaway entries

* Plus+-only competitions

* Selected event credits

* Enhanced referral rewards

* Birthday rewards

* Special equipment-hire benefits



We would like advice on using Stripe securely for subscriptions and ensuring each user’s membership status updates correctly.



Notifications and Communication



We want to develop the ability to communicate through:



* In-app notifications

* Push notifications

*

* SMS for selected campaigns

* Event reminders

* Post-visit follow-ups

* Personalised offers



The long-term goal is to send relevant messages based on location, age brackets and interests without overwhelming members.



Administration Dashboard



We require a simple admin area where non-technical team members can:



* Add and edit events

* Add and edit partner offers

* Add and edit Party Pods

* Create giveaways

* Add winners

* View members

* View membership status

* View referrals

* View check-ins

* Manage rewards

* Send or schedule notifications

* View basic reports

* Track event and offer performance



The dashboard must be straightforward for our remote team to use.



Initial Development Phases



Phase 1 – Paid Prototype



Create a branded, clickable prototype demonstrating:



* Registration

* Home screen

* Events

* Partner offers

* Giveaways

* Party Pod check-in

* Rewards

* Fun Hub Plus+

* Equipment links

* Basic admin dashboard



Phase 2 – Working MVP



Build the functioning mobile web app with:



* Secure member accounts

* Member profiles

* Database

* Events and offers

* Giveaways

* Referrals

* QR check-ins

* Membership levels

* Admin controls

* Basic reporting

*
 or in-app notifications



Phase 3 – Testing and Launch



* Test all important customer journeys

* Test mobile devices and screen sizes

* Review authentication and database permissions

* Fix errors

* Improve performance

* Launch the Progressive Web App

* Provide documentation and team training

* Include an agreed period for correcting launch bugs



Future Phase



If the MVP performs well, future work may include:



* Apple and Android app-store versions

* Full push notifications

* Native phone features

* In-app ticketing

* Loyalty points

* Savings tracking

* More advanced personalisation

* Partner dashboards

* Automated marketing journeys

* Integration with other business systems



Skills We Are Looking For



The ideal applicant will have experience with:



* Lovable or similar AI development tools

* Supabase or Lovable Cloud

* Database design

* Secure user authentication

* Row-level security and user permissions

* Mobile-first app design

* Progressive Web Apps

* QR-code generation and scanning

* Stripe subscriptions and webhooks

*
 and push-notification services

* GitHub

* Capacitor or native app packaging

* GDPR-conscious data collection



You do not need to be an expert in every area, but you must understand how to create secure, reliable applications—not simply generate attractive screens using AI prompts.



Ownership and Security



All business accounts must be created under accounts owned and controlled by our company, including:



* Lovable

* GitHub

* Supabase/database

* Domain and hosting

* Stripe

* Analytics

*
 and notification services

* Apple and Google developer accounts



The Fun4Hire Network must retain full ownership of:



* Source code

* Database

* Designs

* Documentation

* Customer data

* Domains

* Integrations

* All related accounts



We will provide the developer with the access required to complete the work.



Secure database permissions and careful handling of member data are essential.



Who We Are Looking For



We want someone who is:



* Honest, reliable and responsive

* Comfortable communicating in English

* Able to explain technical decisions simply

* Willing to ask questions instead of making risky assumptions

* Focused on creating a simple customer experience

* Careful with customer data and security

* Able to provide realistic prices and timescales

* Interested in a potential long-term relationship

* Available for ongoing support after launch



How to Apply



Please begin your application with the words:



**FUN HUB APP**



This confirms that you have read the full brief.



Please then provide:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your experience with Lovable and Supabase.

3. Links or videos showing relevant apps you have built.

4. A clear explanation of which parts of those projects you personally completed.

5. Your recommended technical approach for our MVP.

6. Whether you recommend Lovable Cloud or an independent Supabase project, and why.

7. Your experience with QR check-ins.

8. Your experience with Stripe subscriptions.

9. Your experience with notifications and
 automation.

10. Your estimated cost and timescale for the prototype.

11. Your estimated cost and timescale for the working MVP.

12. Your hourly rate for future changes and maintenance.

13. Confirmation that all accounts, code and data will remain under our company’s ownership.

14. Any questions or concerns you have about the proposed project.



Please do not send a generic application. We are looking for somebody who has considered the project and can explain how they would approach it.



Paid Trial



We will begin with a small paid prototype milestone before awarding the complete project.



The successful developer could then work with us through the MVP, launch, app-store release and the long-term development of The Fun Hub.

title: Corporate Legal Attorney/Counsel
description:
The Company You’ll Join

We are an evidence-based behavioral health organization committed to using effective, research-supported treatments and staying current with the latest developments in clinical care.

* Accountability for our actions and responsibilities

* Teamwork and collaboration

* Passion for serving our clients and supporting company goals



Position Purpose



The Corporate In-House Attorney provides legal guidance and support to a fast-growing behavioral health organization. This role will help the company manage contracts, regulatory and compliance matters, employment issues, risk, disputes, policies, and other legal needs.



Key Performance Indicators



Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:



* Draft, review, negotiate, and coordinate contracts within agreed timelines.

* Keep legal matter trackers, contract files, templates, and legal records organized and up to date.

* Provide timely legal guidance to company leaders and departments.

* Help reduce unnecessary outside legal expenses by handling appropriate matters internally.

* Coordinate effectively with outside counsel when specialized legal support is needed.

* Support compliance, policy development, training, and audit readiness.

* Identify and escalate high-risk legal matters before they become larger problems.

* Provide clear recommendations, options, and next steps when legal risks arise.

* Maintain accurate documentation and communication related to legal matters.



Core Competencies



The successful candidate should demonstrate:



* Strong knowledge of corporate and business law.

* Good legal judgment and problem-solving skills.

* Strong organization and attention to detail.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information professionally.

* Ability to work independently in a fast-moving organization.

* Strong follow-through and accountability.

* Ability to manage multiple legal matters and competing priorities.

* Ability to identify risks and communicate them clearly.

* Professional and collaborative approach when working with leadership and other departments.



Core Responsibilities



Contract and Legal Support



* Draft, review, and negotiate contracts, leases, vendor agreements, payor agreements, and employment-related documents.

* Review contract terms and identify potential legal and business risks.

* Advise leaders on contract obligations, deadlines, confidentiality, termination rights, and risk allocation.

* Maintain legal templates, approved contract language, and contract playbooks.

title: Marketing VA and Creative Project Coordinator
description:
UK Video Agency, Part Time to Full Time, Long Term



About us



Jay Hipkiss Media is a video led marketing agency in the UK.



We work with local service businesses including dental practices, clinics, property companies and trades, managing their content, ads and social media from planning through to delivery.



Small team, high standards. We are looking for someone who wants to become a long term part of it.



The role



This is a coordination role. You will own the production timeline for our clients.



Right now, too much of that timeline lives in the founder's head. This role exists to change that.



Your job is not to remind someone that something needs doing. We want you to own it. Know what is coming up, prepare as much as possible in advance, chase what is missing, and bring work to the founder when it is already mostly complete.



If a client has a shoot in three weeks, you should already know what needs to happen three weeks out, ten days out, seven days out and after the shoot, without being prompted each time.



Your week will include



- Chasing and confirming shoot dates and pre production calls

- Keeping upcoming shoots, deadlines and client deliverables on schedule

- Following up on quotes, client access, assets and anything else we are waiting on

- Producing first drafts of shoot plans and video scripts using our existing frameworks, previous work and AI tools

- Getting scripts and shoot plans approved by clients before their shoot

- Managing the delivery chain after shoots: downloading approved edits, organising client folders, sending final files

- Following up with clients when videos, scripts or other deliverables still need approval

- Drafting client
s in our voice and sending approved communications

- Booking calls and keeping the calendar accurate

- Scheduling social media posts

- Briefing designers and following up on artwork

- Keeping our CRM, GoHighLevel, tidy and up to date

- Updating our SOPs when processes change or when you receive a useful correction, so the same thing does not need explaining twice



Tools we use



Claude, GoHighLevel, 
, Google Docs, Canva, Gmail, Meta Business Suite.



Experience with GoHighLevel or Claude is a big plus. Full training given on all of our systems.



Who this could suit



You do not need to have held this exact job title before. This could be a great fit if you have worked as a:



- Virtual Assistant in the marketing/content space

- Content Assistant

- Creative Assistant

- Project Coordinator

- Social Media Assistant

- Junior Copywriter

- Marketing Coordinator



Strong VA experience in the marketing or content space, excellent organisation, good writing instincts and confidence with AI tools is what matters. We care far more about how you think and work than whether your previous title matches ours.



To be clear, this is not admin. This is project timeline ownership with creative decisions needing made.



What we are looking for



Excellent written English. You will be communicating with UK business owners, so your writing needs to be clear, natural and professional. We use British English and will give you examples and a style guide.



Very organised. You notice a deadline approaching and deal with it before anyone asks. You enjoy tracking moving parts and closing open loops.



You learn from feedback. You will get plenty, especially early on. What matters is that you understand it, apply it, and improve the process so the same correction becomes less likely next time.



Comfortable with AI. A big part of this role is using AI tools alongside our frameworks, SOPs and previous client work. You will never be staring at a blank page. You will be expected to follow a process, use the right context, produce a strong first draft, and recognise when the output is not good enough.



Some creative judgement. You do not need to be a professional copywriter. You should be able to tell the difference between something that sounds natural and something that sounds generic or obviously AI generated.



Initiative. If something looks wrong, flag it. If something is missing, chase it. If you can solve it yourself with the information and systems available, we would rather you did. The goal of this role is to reduce mental load, not create another inbox of questions.



Hours and pay



Starting at 20 hours per week, with a clear path to full time. For the right person that could happen within a few weeks.



You will need to be available for core overlap between 3pm and 7pm Philippine time. The rest of your hours are flexible.



Pay is $600 to $800 USD per month at 20 hours, rising to $1,200 to $1,600 USD per month at full time, depending on experience and tasks taken.



Payment is twice a month via Wise. Compensation reviewed after six months.



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long term position and can grow with the agency.



How to apply



Put ORANGE as the first word of your subject line. Applications without this will not be considered.



Answer these three questions:



- What tools or systems do you currently use to stay organised, and how do you use them?

- What is one thing you would need from me to do this job well?



No generic, copy and paste cover letters. Your real words will count for more here than speed to apply and experience.



Shortlisted applicants will be given a small paid test task based on real work from the role, before any interview.

They should continuously assess how short-form content is changing and use those insights to introduce new editing techniques, formats and creative approaches that make the content more dynamic, current and engaging.



The role also includes proactive content ideation. I am looking for someone who is genuinely immersed in social media and naturally identifies emerging audios, trends, formats, memes, conversations and cultural moments that could be developed into relevant content ideas.



This is a permanent, full-time position within a fast-paced content business where daily posting is a core priority. Reliability, flexibility, creative initiative, responsiveness and consistently meeting deadlines are essential.



Core Responsibilities

* Edit high-performing short-form content for TikTok and Instagram, across both organic content and paid brand partnerships

* Optimise content for viewer retention, watch time, engagement and overall platform performance

* Use strong creative judgement to strengthen hooks, pacing, structure, storytelling and overall execution

* Proactively identify opportunities within content to improve performance rather than relying on detailed instructions for every creative decision

* Understand the differences between what performs on TikTok and Instagram and adapt editing styles, pacing, formats and creative choices accordingly

* Identify opportunities to strengthen content through relevant visual assets, memes, cultural references, trends, audio and platform-native creative techniques

* Maintain an exceptionally high standard of quality, accuracy and attention to detail

* Take ownership of edits from raw footage through to final approval



Evolving the Editing Style

The successful candidate will be expected to:



* Continuously assess how high-performing short-form content is evolving across TikTok and Instagram

* Proactively introduce new editing styles, techniques and creative approaches that can make the content more dynamic and engaging

* Identify elements of the existing editing style that could be refreshed, improved or replaced

* Suggest and experiment with new approaches to hooks, pacing, visual storytelling, text treatments, graphics, audio and overall content structure

* Recognise emerging editing trends early and assess whether they are genuinely relevant to the creator’s content and audience

* Help ensure the content remains current, competitive and platform-native, rather than relying on an editing formula that becomes dated over time

* Balance creative evolution with consistency so that the content continues to feel recognisably aligned with the creator’s personal brand



The expectation is not simply to follow an established editing template. The editor should bring the experience and creative judgement required to help determine what the editing style should become next.



Content Ideation & Trend Spotting



This role extends beyond editing and includes an important content ideation component.



The successful candidate will be expected to:



* Proactively bring forward content ideas rather than waiting solely for content to be assigned

* Regularly identify trending audios, formats, memes, conversations, cultural moments and emerging social media trends that could be relevant to the creator’s content

* Suggest specific ways those trends could be adapted into original TikTok or Instagram content

* Identify emerging or high-performing content formats and suggest how they could be applied to educational, skincare, beauty, lifestyle or personality-led content

* Bring forward ideas for new hooks, video structures, recurring formats and creative concepts

* Proactively share useful creative references and examples

* Understand the difference between blindly following a trend and identifying trends that can be adapted naturally and strategically to the creator’s audience and personal brand

* Remain sufficiently immersed in TikTok, Instagram and wider social media culture to identify opportunities while they are relevant, rather than once a trend has already passed



For example, if an audio, meme or format begins trending and there is a strong way to adapt it to the creator’s content, the expectation is that the editor would identify that opportunity and proactively suggest the content idea.



Picture Carousels & Canva



* Create high-quality picture carousel content for TikTok and Instagram using Canva

* Turn supplied copy, information and concepts into polished, engaging and platform-appropriate carousel content

* Contribute creative ideas around carousel formats, layouts, hooks and visual treatments

* Maintain a strong and consistent visual identity

* Source relevant imagery, graphics, screenshots and visual references where required

* Keep up to date with evolving carousel styles and formats across TikTok and Instagram

* Help evolve carousel design alongside the broader creative direction of the social channels



Paid Brand Partnerships



* Edit paid brand partnerships to a consistently high standard while maintaining the creator’s organic content style

* Understand and accurately execute campaign briefs and brand requirements

* Balance mandatory brand messaging with the need for content to remain engaging and native to the platform

* Identify creative ways to integrate brand requirements without making the content feel unnecessarily commercial

* Handle brand revisions accurately and efficiently



Seniority & Experience



This is explicitly a senior-level position.



Applicants should have significant professional experience editing short-form social media content and be able to demonstrate a strong portfolio of high-quality work.



The successful candidate must already have the technical foundations expected of an experienced professional editor. This role is focused on a higher level of contribution: creative judgement, strategic thinking, platform knowledge, content performance, creative direction and proactive ideation.



Applicants should be able to demonstrate:



* Significant professional short-form video editing experience

* A strong portfolio of TikTok, Instagram Reels or comparable vertical content

* Experience editing content designed to achieve strong social media performance

* Advanced proficiency in CapCut and/or Adobe Premiere Pro

* Strong proficiency in Canva

* Excellent knowledge of TikTok and Instagram

* A sophisticated understanding of viewer psychology, retention, hooks and short-form storytelling

* Strong awareness of social media culture, emerging trends and platform behaviour

* The ability to distinguish between a fleeting trend and a genuinely valuable creative opportunity

* Strong independent creative judgement

* The confidence to suggest improvements or challenge an existing creative approach where appropriate

* The ability to take ownership of an edit without requiring detailed step-by-step direction

* Strong English comprehension and excellent attention to detail

* Clear and proactive communication

* Strong organisation and time-management skills

* The ability to manage multiple priorities within a fast-moving content environment



What I’m Looking For



The ideal editor is someone who:



* Takes genuine pride in producing exceptionally high-quality work

* Is highly experienced and confident in their creative judgement

* Understands what makes content perform across both TikTok and Instagram and can adapt editing styles, pacing and formats accordingly

* Understands the psychology behind high-performing short-form content

* Knows how to strengthen hooks and improve viewer retention through editing

* Can identify moments where pacing, captions, visuals, memes, cultural references or structure can be improved to maximise performance

* Keeps up to date with TikTok and Instagram trends, formats, platform updates and changes in audience behaviour

* Understands how to incorporate relevant trends naturally into content where appropriate to maximise engagement and performance

* Proactively helps evolve the editing style rather than simply reproducing the existing one

* Is excited by the opportunity to develop new and more dynamic creative approaches as social media evolves

* Regularly brings forward content ideas, trending audios, formats and creative references without needing to be asked

* Thinks beyond the individual edit and contributes to the broader creative direction and performance of the content

* Can follow a creator’s style while also bringing strong creative ideas and suggestions

* Understands when innovation will strengthen a piece of content and when a simpler approach is more effective

* Learns from feedback and consistently applies it to future work

* Communicates clearly and proactively

* Is highly dependable and consistent

* Takes ownership of deliverables and deadlines

* Does not need to be repeatedly chased or micromanaged

* Is comfortable operating at the pace required by a creator publishing content daily



This role supports a creator who is looking to post daily content. Reliability and meeting deadlines are therefore essential.



Turnaround Expectations



This is a fast-paced full-time role, and applicants must be comfortable working to consistently short turnaround times.



First Draft Turnaround



Once raw footage has been received, a fully edited first draft must be delivered within approximately 4–6 hours, depending on the length and complexity of the video.



For particularly complex or editing-intensive videos, turnaround may extend to up to 12 hours.



The expectation is that newly received footage is prioritised and editing begins promptly. This is not a role operating on a traditional freelance editing turnaround of 24–48 hours.



Applicants should only apply if they are genuinely comfortable maintaining this level of turnaround consistently.



Revisions



* Straightforward revisions must be actioned urgently upon receipt of feedback

* More substantial revisions must also be prioritised and completed as quickly as possible

* The editor must remain highly responsive to feedback and revision requests

* Previous feedback must be retained and applied to future edits to minimise unnecessary repeat revision rounds



Flexibility & Availability



This is a full-time role with flexible working hours.



There are no fixed or pre-agreed daily working hours. Instead, the successful candidate must be flexible around the requirements of a fast-moving content schedule.



* The successful candidate must have the flexibility to adapt their working pattern around when footage, feedback and content requirements arise

* Capacity to edit content consistently throughout the week is essential

* Weekend availability is a non-negotiable requirement of the role

* Urgent edits may occasionally require a faster turnaround

* The editor must be highly responsive and able to adapt where necessary to meet content and campaign deadlines

* Any known periods of unavailability must be communicated in advance



Communication, Reliability & Ownership



The successful candidate must:



* Communicate clearly and proactively

* Be highly responsive to new content, feedback and changing priorities

* Keep the creator/team updated on the status of edits where necessary

* Flag potential issues or delays before they affect a deadline

* Take ownership of assigned work rather than requiring repeated follow-up

* Manage priorities independently

* Maintain high standards even when working to fast turnaround times

* Be dependable and consistent



Typical Deliverables



Typical workload includes:



* Approximately 7 short-form videos per week

* Picture carousel content for TikTok and Instagram as required

* A mix of organic content and paid brand partnerships

* Videos generally between 30–90 seconds

* Revisions and alternative versions where required

* Proactive content ideas, trend recommendations and creative references



Workload may fluctuate depending on the content calendar, brand campaigns and wider business requirements.



Confidentiality & Content Ownership



The editor may have access to unreleased content, brand campaign information and other confidential business material.



All footage, content, campaign materials and other confidential information must be treated accordingly and may not be shared, uploaded or repurposed externally without permission.



All final content, project files and creative assets produced as part of the role will remain the property of the business.



Role Details



Position: Senior Short-Form Video Editor & Content Strategist

Employment: Full-time, permanent / long-term

Location: Remote

Hours: Full-time with flexible working hours based around content requirements and deadlines

Weekend availability: Required and non-negotiable

Start Date: As soon as possible



Application Requirements



Please include:



* Your CV/resume

* A portfolio of relevant short-form content within the niches outlined above, including educational, skincare, beauty, lifestyle, health and/or creator-led content

* At least 7–10 examples of TikTok, Instagram Reels or comparable short-form content that you have personally edited

* Examples that demonstrate a range of editing styles, formats and creative approaches where possible

* Examples of TikTok or Instagram picture carousels you have created

* A clear explanation of which elements of the portfolio examples you were personally responsible for

* Your editing software of choice

* Confirmation of your proficiency with CapCut and/or Adobe Premiere Pro

* Confirmation of your proficiency with Canva

* Your typical turnaround time for a 30–90 second short-form video

* Your current timezone and location

* Your availability

* Your earliest possible start date

* Confirmation that you can work full-time with flexible hours

* Confirmation that you can provide regular weekend availability



Please only apply if you have significant professional experience editing high-performing short-form content, are comfortable contributing proactively to content ideation and creative direction, and can consistently work to the fast turnaround times outlined above.



Editing Test



Shortlisted applicants will be required to complete a practical editing test using supplied raw footage as part of the recruitment process.



The test will be used to assess:



* Overall editing ability and technical execution

* Creative judgement

* Understanding of high-performing short-form content

* Ability to strengthen hooks, pacing, structure and viewer retention

* Ability to identify opportunities to make content more dynamic and engaging

* Understanding of TikTok and Instagram editing styles and platform-native content

* Ability to follow creative direction while also demonstrating independent creative thinking

* Attention to detail

* Ability to interpret and apply a brief accurately

* Turnaround speed

* Overall suitability for the creative standard and pace required for the role

title: Builder's VA
description:
Builder’s Executive Assistant & Project Coordinator – Construction



Full-Time | Remote | Sydney, Australia Hours

Salary: Competitive – based on experience



MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS



To be considered for this role, you must have:



A qualification in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Estimating, Quantity Surveying or a closely related construction field

Previous experience working within the Australian residential building industry

A good understanding of Australian residential construction, plans, estimating, project administration and building processes

Excellent written and spoken English



Please only apply if you meet these requirements.



About Us



We’re Acme Built, a premium residential building company based in Sydney, Australia.



We specialise in high-end renovations, extensions and custom homes. We care about delivering a great result for our clients, with strong communication, organisation and attention to detail throughout the build.



We’re looking for a long-term team member who can become the Director’s right-hand person and play an important role in both our projects and business operations.



This isn’t just an admin position.



Your construction knowledge will be important. You’ll help with project administration, estimating, purchasing, job costing, systems and day-to-day coordination.



About the Role



You’ll work directly with the Director to keep projects organised, clients informed and the business running efficiently.



Your goal is to take ownership of administration and project coordination so the Director can spend more time managing projects, growing the business and looking after clients.



Every day will be different. We want someone who can see what needs to be done, take ownership and follow tasks through to completion.



Your Responsibilities-



Executive Assistant:

Manage the Director’s inbox and calendar

Draft professional
s and correspondence

Follow up outstanding actions

Organise meetings and appointments

Take meeting minutes and maintain action lists

Assist with travel and personal assistant tasks when required



Project Administration:

Maintain Buildertrend across all active projects

Prepare weekly client updates

Maintain project documentation and digital filing

Coordinate inspections and project milestones

Prepare variations and client approvals

Track selections and outstanding decisions

Assist with project handover documentation

Review construction plans and project information

Estimating & Pre-Construction Support

Assist with residential construction estimates

Review architectural and engineering plans

Prepare and send trade and supplier quote requests

Compare quotations and scopes

Assist with take-offs and pricing

Maintain our historical pricing database

Assist with tender preparation

Help track estimated costs against actual project costs

Support purchasing and procurement

Financial Administration

Enter supplier invoices

Match invoices against purchase orders

Assist with job costing

Track project budgets

Monitor estimated versus actual costs

Assist with financial reporting through Xero

Identify missing invoices, purchase orders or cost information



Client Communication:

Respond to client enquiries

Schedule client meetings

Track client selections and approvals

Maintain HubSpot CRM records

Coordinate welcome packs, handovers and client gifts

Follow up outstanding client information



Supplier & Trade Coordination:

Request supplier and subcontractor quotations

Follow up outstanding quotes

Issue purchase orders and work orders

Maintain supplier and subcontractor databases

Track licences, insurance and compliance documentation

Assist with trade scheduling and project coordination



Systems & Business Operations:

Improve business systems and workflows

Create SOPs, checklists and templates

Maintain document libraries

Improve the way we use Buildertrend and our other software

Assist with reporting and dashboards

Identify repetitive tasks that can be improved or automated

Help implement new systems rather than simply documenting them



Software You’ll Use:

Buildertrend

Buildxact

HubSpot

Microsoft 365

Google Workspace

Xero

DocuSign

HazardCo

WhatsApp

AI tools



You don’t need experience with every platform. We can teach you our systems.



Your construction knowledge, attitude and ability to learn are more important.



We’re Looking For Someone Who

Has strong knowledge of Australian residential construction

Can confidently read architectural and engineering plans

Understands construction terminology and building processes

Has excellent written and spoken English

Is highly organised and detail-focused

Takes ownership without needing constant direction

Enjoys creating systems and improving processes

Is proactive and follows through

Can confidently communicate with clients, suppliers and trades

Can manage multiple projects and priorities

Works independently while remaining accountable

Is comfortable learning new technology and AI tools

Wants a long-term career with one company

Highly Regarded Experience



We’d especially like to hear from candidates with experience in:



Australian residential estimating

Quantity take-offs

Buildertrend

Buildxact

Construction project administration

Procurement and purchasing

Job costing

Residential renovations and extensions

Working directly with an Australian builder or construction company

What Success Looks Like



Within your first few months, you will:



Keep the Director’s inbox and action list organised

Keep Buildertrend up to date across our projects

Send weekly client updates on time

Follow up suppliers and trades without being asked

Assist with estimating and pre-construction

Keep project costs and documentation organised

Improve systems and processes

Identify issues before they become problems

Reduce the Director’s administration workload

Become someone the Director can rely on to keep things moving

Why Join Acme Built?



We genuinely care about our people and our clients.



You’ll work directly with the business owner and have real responsibility from day one. You won’t simply complete admin tasks — you’ll have the opportunity to understand the business, improve how we operate and become an important part of the team.



As we grow, we see this role developing further into estimating, pre-construction, project coordination and business operations, with genuine opportunities for greater responsibility and leadership.



We’re looking for someone who wants to stay with us for years, grow with the company and make the role their own.



How to Apply



Please send us:



Your resume

Details of your Engineering, Architecture, Estimating, Quantity Surveying or relevant construction qualification

A short 2–3 minute video introducing yourself

An explanation of your experience within the Australian residential building industry

Examples of the types of residential projects you have worked on

Details of any estimating, take-off, purchasing or project administration experience

The construction software you have used

Your expected monthly salary in AUD

Your internet speed

Your computer specifications



Important: This position requires previous Australian residential construction experience and a relevant construction qualification.



We look forward to meeting you.

title: Customer Support & Chargeback Specialist (E-commerce) | Full-Time, Long-Term
description:
Customer Support & Chargeback Specialist (E-commerce) | Full-Time, Long-Term



Salary: $450/month to start, full-time, with performance bonuses and salary reviews every quarter. We promote from within and pay for results, so there is significant room to grow your salary over time.



About Us



We are a fast-growing international e-commerce brand selling health and beauty products across the UK, US, Canada, and Australia. We are a small, sharp team that values intelligence, ownership, and doing things properly.



You will not be alone. You will work side by side with our current customer support specialist, who will train you and share the workload, and you will have direct contact with both founders. Real responsibility from day one, but with full support behind you.



The Role



You will be the backbone of our customer support operation. Your job is to keep customers happy, resolve issues quickly and professionally, and help us build systems that make support run smoothly as we scale.



Your responsibilities



- Handle the customer support inbox daily 
) with fast, professional, well-written replies

- Manage order issues: tracking questions, address changes, refunds, subscription questions

- Follow and improve our support templates and escalation processes

- Create and maintain SOPs in Notion so every process is documented and repeatable

- Keep organized records in Google Sheets / Excel

- Handle chargebacks and payment disputes: gather evidence, organize documentation, and prepare dispute responses following our proven playbook

- Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) effectively in your daily work to draft, research, and work faster without sacrificing quality



Requirements (must-haves)



- Perfect written English. Not "good". Perfect. Your replies go directly to customers in the UK, US, Canada, and Australia.

- High attention to detail and strong logical thinking. You can read a situation, understand what actually happened, and choose the right response without being told every step.

- Experience with chargebacks and payment disputes (Visa, Mastercard, PayPal). You will be responsible for preparing dispute responses, so you must understand evidence requirements and how disputes work. Tell us about your experience in detail in your application.

- Comfortable using AI tools and LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) as part of your daily workflow. You know how to prompt well, verify outputs, and use AI to work faster without letting quality slip.

- E-commerce customer support experience(Shopify experience is a strong plus)

- Notion proficiency is required. You should be comfortable creating structured documentation and SOPs in Notion.

- Comfortable with Google Sheets and Excel

- Highly organized, self-managing, and reliable. You take ownership and do not need micromanagement.

- Available full-time and looking for a long-term, stable position. We are not looking for freelancers juggling multiple clients.



Big plus (not required)



- Experience with subscription-based businesses

- Experience with PayPal disputes dashboard, or similar

- Experience winning Visa or Mastercard disputes specifically (if you know what compelling evidence means, mention it)



What We Offer



- $450/month full-time starting salary

- Performance bonuses

- Salary review every quarter. Strong performers grow fast here.

- Long-term stability. We want someone who stays and grows with the company for years.

- A real team: you work alongside an experienced support specialist and have direct access to both founders

- Real responsibility and a role that expands as you prove yourself



How to Apply



Read carefully. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.



1. Start your application with the word **PINEAPPLE** as the very first word.

2. In 3 to 5 sentences, describe the most difficult customer support situation you have handled and exactly how you resolved it.

3. Answer this scenario in your own words : A customer
s saying "I never received my order" but the tracking shows it was delivered 5 days ago to their address. Write the exact reply you would send to this customer.

4. Tell us your experience level with Notion (be honest) and describe your experience with chargebacks and disputes: which platforms, which dispute types, and your results.

5. Include your expected start date.



We reply to every serious application.

title: Business Development Manager – Full-Cycle B2B Sales
description:
Business Development Manager – Full-Cycle B2B Sales



Arkero is building a new way for businesses to hire skilled remote professionals, without traditional recruitment fees, large upfront costs or weeks of waiting.



We are looking for experienced Business Development Managers who want more than just a basic salary.



This is a full-cycle sales position.



You will be responsible for finding your own prospects, starting the conversation, managing the sales process and closing the client.



You will:



1 - Find and prospect potential business clients

2 - Speak directly with business owners and decision-makers

3 - Identify their staffing needs and pain points

4 - Explain the Arkero model clearly and confidently

5 - Handle objections

6 - Follow up your opportunities

7 - Close the client and secure their commitment to hire

8 - Manage your own pipeline from prospecting through to close

9 - Work closely with the wider sales and operations team



This is not an appointment-setting role, and you will not simply be handed warm leads to close.



You are expected to create your own opportunities and turn those opportunities into new Arkero clients.



Arkero has been designed to remove many of the barriers that normally make staffing difficult to sell.



There are no traditional placement fees or large upfront recruitment costs for the client, making the conversation much simpler.



This is a performance-focused role with a strong bonus structure.



Base Rate:

$3.00 USD per hour, 40 hours per week



Performance Bonuses:

Placements 3–5: $170 USD per placement

Placements 6–10: $200 USD per placement

Placements 11+: $250 USD per placement



There is also a pathway to increase your base rate based on consistent performance.



Our expectation is not that you simply meet the minimum.



We are looking for salespeople who want to build towards 10, 15 or more placements per month and earn accordingly.



Month 1 is your ramp-up period, with a target of 3 successful placements.



From Month 2 onwards, the minimum performance requirement is 5 successful placements per month.



You will be part of the Arkero team, working alongside other BDMs, Growth Partners, Talent and Operations.



We want to create a fun, competitive and supportive sales culture where people are hungry to succeed but also want the people around them to succeed.



Every two months, we will run team prizes and performance awards, with major prizes including the latest iPhone Pro, Samsung flagship phones, HP OmniBook laptops and other rewards.



These prizes will not only be about who has the highest sales number.



Performance matters, but so does how you work with your team, support others, share knowledge, help people improve and contribute to the culture we are building.



We share the wins, learn from the losses and help each other get better.



We want great salespeople, but we also want great teammates.



We are looking for people who:



1 - Have strong spoken and written English

2 - Have previous B2B sales experience

3 - Are confident speaking on the phone

4 - Can find their own prospects and close their own deals

5 - Are comfortable being measured on results

6 - Are persistent without being aggressive

7 - Can manage a pipeline and follow-up process

8 - Want their income to grow with their performance

9 - Genuinely enjoy sales and winning business

10 -Enjoy being part of a competitive team environment

11 - Are willing to help and support the people around them



If you are looking for a role where you can perform at a high level, earn strong bonuses, compete for meaningful rewards and grow with a company from an early stage, we would like to hear from you.



Please only apply if you are genuinely interested in the opportunity and are prepared to communicate throughout the recruitment process.



Responsiveness is important in sales, and it is important to us as a team. If you regularly leave messages unanswered or are difficult to reach, this role will not be the right fit.



When applying, please tell us:



1 - Your previous B2B sales experience

2 - Whether you have worked in a full-cycle sales role where you found your own prospects and closed them yourself

3 - What you personally consider a good monthly sales target

4 - Why you believe you would succeed in a performance-driven sales environment

- Previous experience with
-based customer support, ticketing systems, or similar platforms.

- Able to handle complaints without becoming defensive or taking things personally.

- Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

- Comfortable working independently and managing multiple customer requests.

- Quick to learn new products, systems, policies, and processes.

- Reliable, organized, and someone who takes real ownership of their work.

- Know how to write an
 that sounds warm, natural, and human—not like it came straight from a script.

- Can be professional without sounding stiff or robotic.

- Know how to explain things clearly, even when the situation is complicated.

- Have good judgment and can figure out what to do when there isn’t an obvious answer.

- Stay calm when a customer is upset.

- Pay attention to details because you understand that one small mistake can completely change a customer’s experience.

- Don’t wait for someone else to fix a problem when you can take ownership and solve it yourself.

- Care about the overall customer experience, not just answering the question in front of you.

- Long-term opportunity with a growing e-commerce company

- Remote work

- Supportive and collaborative team environment

- Opportunity to work with an international e-commerce brand

- Exposure to a growing portfolio of beauty and consumer products

- Opportunity to grow with the company as the team expands



How to Apply



If you’re a strong communicator, a good problem-solver, and the kind of person who genuinely cares about how customers feel after interacting with you, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your CV/resume along with a short introduction telling us:



- Your customer service experience

- Your experience with Reamaze and Shopify

- The types of customer issues you’ve handled before

- Why you think you’d be a great fit for this role

- We’re looking for someone who can do more than answer
s. We’re looking for someone who knows how to make customers feel taken care of. Put the word “GRATITUDE” in the subject line and nothing else.

We build and grow websites for our clients on WordPress + Elementor, and run a structured local SEO service built around competitor gap analysis, thematic content silos, and monthly reporting. 5. Blogging (AI-assisted) — support our AI-driven content workflow to keep client blogs and content silos moving

SEMrush and Ahrefs for competitor and keyword research — this is the core skill for the role

title: Performance Video Editor — AI-Driven DTC Health Ads / Creative Strategist Growth Path ($1,500/mo+)
description:
We are a $600K/month DTC oral health supplement brand running direct response video ads on Meta to women 50+ in the United States. We are hiring a full-time Performance Video Editor who can bring scripts to life, not just cut them together.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS:



You are not editing vlogs, YouTube videos, or social media content. You are editing direct response video ads that run on cold traffic at real ad spend. Every frame, every transition, every piece of b-roll, every voiceover cut exists for one reason: to keep a skeptical 55-year-old woman watching long enough to click. If the ad doesn't perform, it gets killed. The edit is the difference between an ad that scales and an ad that dies in testing.



If you have only edited brand content, social media reels, or YouTube videos, this role is not for you. We need someone who has edited ads that ran on cold traffic for e-commerce or supplement brands and understands why some ads convert and others don't.



WHAT YOU WILL DO:



You will receive scripts and turn them into finished, launch-ready video ads for Meta. But you are not just following instructions. You are making creative decisions on every ad:



Choosing and generating the right b-roll for every section of the script. Not just "find a clip that matches the words." You are d
 what visual makes the viewer FEEL something at that exact moment in the ad.

Pacing the hook so the first 3 seconds stop the scroll. You understand that the hook isn't just the first line of the script. It's the first visual, the first sound, the first text on screen, and the speed at which all three hit at the same time.

Matching voiceover tone to the script's intent. A fear-based ad sounds different than a discovery ad. A doctor ad sounds different than a personal story. You know the difference and you cast the voice accordingly.

Selecting music that supports the emotion without competing with the voiceover. Subtle, intentional, never generic.

Designing caption styles and on-screen text that feel native to the platform, not like a corporate presentation.

Building transitions that move the viewer through the ad without them noticing. No flashy effects for the sake of effects. Every cut serves the story.



You are bringing an ad to life through visual creative decisions. Not just editing. Performing.



AI IS NOT OPTIONAL:



We use AI tools heavily and daily. This is not a traditional editing role where you sit in Premiere for 8 hours cutting footage someone else shot. You are generating AI UGC, AI voiceovers, AI b-roll, AI animations, and combining them with real footage to create ads that look and feel authentic.



The tools we use include:



Higgsfield for AI video generation, character animation, and b-roll creation

ElevenLabs for AI voiceovers and voice cloning

Runway for motion and visual generation

CapCut or Premiere for editing

Canva for thumbnails and static elements



If you are not already using AI tools like these in your daily editing workflow, this role is not for you. We are not looking for someone who is "willing to learn AI." We need someone who already generates AI assets as part of how they edit. This is what separates a performance editor from a traditional editor.



WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM OTHER EDITING JOBS:



Most editing jobs hand you footage and say "make it look good." This role hands you a script and says "make it convert." The difference is that you are thinking about performance at every step:



Why does this hook need to hit in under 2 seconds?

Why does the b-roll need to shift at the mechanism section?

Why does the pacing need to slow down when the product is introduced?

Why does the CTA need urgency without feeling desperate?



If you already think like this when you edit, you will thrive here. If you have never thought about why an ad performs, only about whether it looks clean, this is not the right fit.



THE GROWTH PATH:



You start as an editor. You receive scripts, you make creative decisions on visuals and pacing, and you deliver finished ads. The founder writes the scripts and provides direction.



Over time, as you learn the brand, the audience, and the mechanism, you will grow into a full creative strategist. That means:



Coming up with your own ad concepts and angles

Writing your own short scripts (20-45 seconds)

Editing and delivering the complete ad independently



The goal is for you to eventually own the full creative pipeline for video ads: concept, script, edit, deliver. One person, full production. This is a long-term role with real growth, not a short-term gig.



WHAT YOU MUST ALREADY HAVE:



Direct response video editing experience. You have edited ads that ran on cold traffic for e-commerce, DTC, or supplement brands. Not brand content. Not social media reels. Ads that had to convert.

AI-native workflow. You already use Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, Runway, or equivalent tools daily. AI UGC, AI voiceovers, AI b-roll generation are part of how you work, not something you've tried once.

Hook psychology. You understand what makes the first 3 seconds of an ad stop the scroll. You can explain why specific hooks work, not just edit them.

Performance awareness. You know what hook rate, hold rate, CTR, and ROAS mean. You understand that editing decisions directly impact ad performance. If an ad underperforms, you can look at the metrics and identify what needs to change in the edit.

Health or supplement niche experience preferred. You have edited ads for products targeting an older demographic (40-65+), health-conscious buyers, or supplement brands. You understand that this audience responds differently than a 25-year-old buying a gadget.

Strong creative instincts. If given only a script with minimal direction, you know exactly what b-roll to use, what voice to cast, how fast to pace it, and how to make the ad feel like content rather than a commercial.



THIS ROLE IS NOT:



YouTube video editing

Brand content or social media management

Podcast editing

Motion graphics or logo animation work

A junior position where you will learn editing on the job



If your portfolio is YouTube videos, wedding videos, vlogs, or brand content, please do not apply.



COMPENSATION AND DETAILS:



Starting at $1,500 USD per month with performance-based increases as you take on more creative responsibility

Full-time, 40 hours per week

Fully remote

Flexible schedule with daily output expected and end-of-day check-ins via WhatsApp

2-week paid trial period. Week 1 is onboarding and editing from provided scripts. Week 2 is independent production. If the quality and speed meet our standard, the role becomes permanent.

Long-term position with a clear growth path into creative strategy



HOW TO APPLY:



Do NOT apply through OnlineJobs.ph.



Apply only through this Google Form:





Applications submitted through the OnlineJobs.ph apply button will not be reviewed.

- 3 hours per day

 etc.)

Specific mascot/avatar/character ideas with clear collectible and fandom appeal.

title: Meta Ads Performance & Reporting Coordinator
description:
I’m looking for ONE full-time Meta Ads Performance & Reporting Coordinator to monitor advertising campaigns for touring comedians, comedy producers and live comedy venues.



We run a high volume of campaigns, primarily focused on selling tickets through Meta Ads.



Your job is to make sure every live campaign is regularly checked, performance issues are caught early, and client reporting is completed accurately and on time.



This is not a senior media buyer or marketing strategy role.



At first, you will work within our existing processes and escalation rules. As you learn how we run campaigns, you will take ownership of more routine optimization decisions yourself.



What You’ll Be Doing



You will monitor active campaigns inside Meta Ads Manager and track performance across metrics including:



Spend

Purchases

Cost per purchase

Revenue

ROAS

Budget pacing

Campaign delivery

Purchase tracking



You’ll make sure every live campaign is reviewed on schedule and that no campaign is left running for days without someone checking it.



You’ll identify campaigns that are performing poorly, not spending correctly, or showing possible tracking problems.



You’ll investigate basic issues, make routine optimizations once trained, and escalate anything unusual or outside your level of responsibility.



You’ll also:



Keep clear notes on campaign performance and changes

Update campaign health/status information

Prepare and send standardized client reports

Check reporting data for accuracy

Track campaigns that require additional attention

Flag performance or tracking issues before they become larger problems



The goal is simple:



Every live campaign should have competent eyes on it, without the founder needing to personally check every campaign.



What You Need

Previous experience using Meta Ads Manager

Understanding of campaign performance metrics

Understanding of purchases, CPA/cost per purchase and ROAS

Basic understanding of the Meta Pixel and conversion tracking

Strong attention to detail

Good written English

Comfortable working with numbers

Ability to follow an established process

Ability to manage a large number of active campaigns

Comfortable investigating issues before escalating them

Comfortable asking questions instead of guessing

Reliable internet connection

Full-time availability



Experience with live events, ticket sales, local advertising or entertainment clients is helpful, but not required.



We are open to training the right person if they understand Meta Ads basics, learn quickly and have strong attention to detail.



Who This Is For



This role will suit someone who naturally checks numbers, notices unusual changes, follows recurring processes consistently and does not need to be reminded which campaigns need attention.



You should be comfortable looking at a campaign and asking:



“Does this look normal? If not, why?”



At first, you’ll be expected to escalate most meaningful optimization decisions.



As you learn our campaigns and processes, you’ll be trusted to handle more of these decisions yourself.



The comedians we work with often use strong language and adult humour, so you should be comfortable working with that.



This Is NOT

A senior marketing strategy role

A campaign-building role

A creative role

A sales role

An account management role

A general virtual assistant role



You will not be responsible for advertising The Warm Up Guys, generating leads for our business, or managing our own marketing campaigns.



Your primary responsibility is monitoring and improving campaigns after they go live, and making sure reporting is completed accurately.



What Success Looks Like

Every live campaign is reviewed on schedule

Performance problems are identified early

Tracking issues are caught quickly

Reports are accurate and sent on time

Routine optimizations are handled correctly

Anything unusual is escalated with clear context

Campaign notes and statuses stay current

Over time, fewer campaign-performance decisions require the founder

Working Hours and Compensation



This is a full-time role working approximately 40 hours per week on a standard Philippine daytime schedule.



Compensation is US$750 to US$850 per month, depending on experience.



You will work with our internal team and will not initially be responsible for direct client account management.



We are hiring an individual team member for a long-term role.



Applications from agencies, outsourcing companies, or applicants planning to subcontract the work will not be considered.



To Be Considered



Please follow these instructions exactly.



Use the word ROAS in your subject line

Select 6 AP points when applying

Briefly describe your experience using Meta Ads

Briefly describe how you have monitored or optimized campaign performance in the past



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.
