title: Senior Transport Operations Officer (Dispatch / Fleet Management / Transport Operations)
description:
Job Description

Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Transport Operations Officer

Job Type: Remote / Part-Time 

Job Hours:  ~25 Hours Per Week

Reports to: Operations Manager

Direct Reports: Transport Operations Support

Start Date: June 2026



About Priority Haulage

Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary

Priority Haulage is seeking a capable, high-capacity, and dependable Transport Operations Officer to support day-to-day operations within a fast-paced, high-accountability environment.



The role reports primarily to the Operations Manager and works closely with the Financial Controller on systems, process improvement, and operational coordination initiatives.



This position is central to maintaining operational continuity across fleet dispatch, driver management, compliance coordination, and transport administration within a structured, performance-driven business focused on operational efficiency, accountability, and scalable systems.



Role Overview

This role is suited to an operations professional who can consistently deliver reliable outcomes with minimal supervision in a deadline-driven environment. Performance will be assessed based on operational consistency, responsiveness, task completion, communication quality, and ability to maintain established workflows and standards.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent coverage aligned with New Zealand business operations, including early morning dispatch coordination and operational responsiveness throughout the day.



Core Operational Coverage (PHT)

5:00 AM – 1:00 PM: Primary operational window covering fleet dispatch, job loading, driver coordination, and daily operational tasks.



2:00 PM – 5:00 PM: Flexible operational coverage period supporting job closing activities, operational follow-up, and preparation/loading for the following operational cycle as required.



The role is workflow and task-driven, with hours and workload fluctuating depending on job volume, fleet activity, and operational requirements. Compensation is based on actual hours worked.



Final working arrangements and compensation structure will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate based on operational requirements, workflow demands, and demonstrated capability within the role. The position is expected to require approximately ~25 - 30 hours per week, with baseline workload increasing as operational responsibilities expand.



Job Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities



Fleet Dispatch

• Job Processing

• Job Quality Control



Fleet Management

• Fleet Maintenance Coordination

• EROAD Management

• Fuel Management



Driver Management

• Logbook Compliance

• Leave Management

• Uniform Inventory Management

• Driver Records Management

• Performance Management Support



Operational Support & Administration

• Support cross-functional operational workflows.

• Maintain accurate operational records and documentation.

• Assist with operational coordination and process improvement.

• Support internal communication, task coordination, and workflow follow-up.

• Assist leadership with operational reporting and action tracking where required.



Progressive Responsibilities

The successful candidate will progressively support and coordinate additional operational safety and compliance functions as part of the wider operations role, including:



• Compliance & Risk Support

• Insurance Claims Coordination

• Health & Safety Administration



Required Experience & Capability

Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating within a structured, deadline-driven transport or logistics environment:

• Minimum 6+ years’ hands-on experience managing high-volume transport dispatch, fleet coordination, and operational workflows.

• Proven experience within transport, logistics, dispatch, or fleet operations environments.

• Strong organisational and commercial judgement, with the ability to manage multiple operational priorities simultaneously.

• Demonstrated experience using Transport Management Systems (TMS), fleet management platforms, dispatch systems, or operational workflow software.

• Ability to operate independently within a remote work environment

• Effective problem-solving capability and operational judgement.

• Intermediate Microsoft Excel capability, including, filtering, sorting, and pivot tables

• A high level of technical proficiency across the Microsoft platform and modern operational business systems, with working familiarity in tools such as:

o Notion

o ChatGPT



Preferred Experience 

• Exposure to New Zealand or Australian transport and logistics environments.

• Exposure to health & safety, driver compliance, and quality control processes.

• Demonstrated ability to improve operational workflows through process optimisation, system improvement, or automation initiatives.

• Exposure to coordinating, supporting, or overseeing operational staff within a structured operations environment.



Personal Attributes

• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

title: Accounting & Marketing Assistant
description:
You have successfully maintained the books and accounting for an Australian business turning over $5 million or more and are now looking for a broader role where you can take on greater responsibility and contribute beyond finance in a key position.



Reporting to the Australian management team, you'll take ownership of the day-to-day bookkeeping and financial administration.  You'll maintain accurate financial records, complete reconciliations, manage accounts payable and receivable, and prepare timely financial information and management reports. You'll also work alongside our external accountant, who manages the BAS and taxation requirements.



Beyond the accounting responsibilities, you'll enjoy a varied role supporting the business in other key areas. This includes coordinating marketing activities with our Australian team to grow Yum Tasmanian’s online presence, assisting with grant applications, and contributing to a range of business initiatives. 



Yum Tasmanian is a proudly Australian, family-owned business that has been supplying premium potatoes throughout Australia for more than 30 years. Beginning as an organic potato producer in 1994, the business has grown into a nationally recognised supplier to major retailers including Coles, Woolworths, IGA, independent retailers and wholesale markets.



Today, the group operates across several businesses within agriculture, fresh produce and related industries. As the business continues to grow, there is a strong focus on building the Yum brand, educating consumers and expanding its online presence through organic marketing.



We want you to be a driver in helping us build Yum into Australia's most recognised online potato brand by growing our organic digital presence to over 1 million Instagram and
 followers through organic marketing.



The role is Monday to Friday, working from an office. In return for your great performance, you’ll be supported with autonomy, rewards and more opportunity for growth over time.

title: Healthcare Recruiter – Australia | Remote (AEST)
description:
Healthcare Recruiter – Australia | Remote (AEST)

Arise Care Staff Pty Ltd

Location: Remote | Australian Business Hours (AEST)

Employment: Full-time

Salary: ₱35,000–₱50,000 per month + sales commission + bonuses

Equipment: Applicants must have their own laptop

We’re Hiring – Healthcare Recruitment Specialist

Arise Care Staff Pty Ltd is seeking an experienced and proactive Healthcare Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our growing Australian healthcare agency.

We recruit and place Registered Nurses, Enrolled Nurses, Aged Care Workers, Personal Care Assistants (PCAs), Clinical Care Coordinators and Mental Health professionals across Australia.

This is an opportunity for a results-driven recruitment professional who can manage the full recruitment lifecycle, build strong candidate pipelines and help ensure our healthcare clients have access to quality staff when they need them.

About the Role

You will be responsible for managing end-to-end recruitment, from identifying workforce requirements and sourcing candidates through to screening, interviews, offers, onboarding and successful placement.

You will work closely with candidates, hiring managers, healthcare clients and external recruitment partners while maintaining a strong focus on candidate experience, retention, compliance and client satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage end-to-end recruitment across multiple healthcare vacancies.

• Proactively source, attract, screen and engage qualified candidates.

• Advertise vacancies through SEEK, Indeed and other recruitment platforms.

• Maintain accurate recruitment pipelines and candidate records.

• Coordinate interviews, offers, contracts and placements.

• Manage replacement recruitment quickly to minimise staffing gaps.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with candidates and clients.

• Monitor recruitment KPIs, deadlines and workforce requirements.

• Ensure candidates meet Healthcare Compliance Requirements.

• Monitor recruitment market trends and identify new talent-sourcing opportunities.

• Identify and implement improvements to recruitment processes and workflows.About You

We are looking for someone who is:

• Experienced in talent acquisition, recruitment or healthcare recruitment.

• Highly organised and comfortable managing multiple vacancies simultaneously.

• Familiar with Australian Labour laws and healthcare compliance requirements.

• Confident sourcing candidates and building talent pipelines.

• Experienced with candidate screening, interviewing, offers and recruitment administration.

• Familiar with SEEK, Indeed or similar recruitment platforms.

• An excellent communicator with strong written and spoken English.

• Highly computer literate and detail-oriented.

• Confident managing challenging conversations and resolving conflicts professionally.

• Comfortable working towards recruitment KPIs and tight deadlines.

• Resilient, adaptable and able to remain composed under pressure.

• Commercially aware and knowledgeable about recruitment market conditions.

• Relationship-focused, with strong emotional intelligence and a commitment to positive candidate and client experiences.

Essential Requirements

• Minimum 2–3 years’ experience in recruitment, talent acquisition or a similar role.

• Healthcare or allied-health recruitment experience is highly desirable.

• Demonstrated experience managing multiple vacancies and recruitment processes.

• Strong understanding of the Australian recruitment market is highly regarded.

• Excellent stakeholder management skills.

• Strong administrative, reporting and organisational skills.

• Ability to work Australian business hours (AEST).

• Own laptop and reliable remote-working setup.

Software Skills

Experience with:

• SEEK, Indeed or similar recruitment platforms

• Microsoft Office 365

• Microsoft Excel

• Recruitment/ATS and candidate tracking systems

• Microsoft Teams, Zoom or similar communication platforms

Education

A bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Management or a related field is preferred.

Relevant recruitment or talent acquisition experience will also be highly regarded.

Why Join Arise Care Staff?

• Work remotely with an Australian healthcare recruitment agency.

• Full-time opportunity working Australian business hours.

• Competitive base salary plus commission and performance bonuses.

• Be part of a growing healthcare recruitment business.

• Make a direct impact on healthcare staffing and workforce outcomes.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced recruiter who knows how to source great people, build strong relationships and deliver results, we’d love to hear from you.

Join Arise Care Staff Pty Ltd and help us connect exceptional healthcare professionals with opportunities across Australia.

title: Shopify Landing Page Builder / CRO Designer
description:
Location: Remote — Philippines

Employment Type: Full-Time

Start Date: Immediate Hire



About the Role



We’re looking for a Shopify Landing Page Builder / CRO Designer who can take a concept, reference, wireframe, or brief and turn it into a polished, high-converting Shopify landing page.



This is not just a basic page-building role. You should have a strong eye for design, user experience, e-commerce, and conversion rate optimization. You’ll be working across different brands and products, creating landing pages designed to look premium while also driving sales.



You should be comfortable working independently, moving quickly, taking feedback, and understanding that a beautiful page is only successful if it converts visitors into customers.



What You’ll Be Doing

Build complete Shopify landing pages and product pages

Create pages using Shopify themes and popular page builders such as Replo, PageFly, GemPages, Shogun, or similar tools

Turn Figma designs, competitor references, wireframes, screenshots, or written briefs into finished Shopify pages

Design pages with a strong focus on conversion rate optimization (CRO)

Structure landing pages using proven e-commerce principles, including:

Strong hero sections

Clear value propositions

Product benefits

Social proof and reviews

Comparison sections

Trust elements

FAQs

Offers and bundles

Strong calls to action

Ensure pages are fully optimized for desktop and mobile

Improve existing Shopify pages based on conversion performance and feedback

Make visual and structural improvements without needing every detail explained

Work with copywriters, designers, marketers, and other members of the team

Implement basic Shopify customizations when required

Maintain consistent branding across each website

QA pages before launch to ensure everything works correctly

What We’re Looking For



You should have:



Strong experience working with Shopify

Previous experience building Shopify landing pages

A good understanding of e-commerce design

Strong visual design skills and attention to detail

An understanding of conversion rate optimization

Knowledge of how customers behave on e-commerce websites

Experience creating mobile-responsive pages

Ability to recreate designs accurately from references or Figma

Ability to work quickly without sacrificing quality

Strong attention to spacing, typography, hierarchy, imagery, buttons, and overall page flow

Ability to follow brand guidelines while still using your own judgment

Good written and spoken English

Strong communication skills

Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines

A proactive attitude — we want someone who can identify problems and suggest improvements rather than simply waiting for instructions

Bonus Skills



These are not essential, but they are a major advantage:



Experience with Replo

Experience with GemPages, PageFly, Shogun, Zipify, or similar Shopify builders

Figma experience

Basic HTML/CSS/Liquid knowledge

Experience with Shopify 2.0 themes

Experience working with DTC/e-commerce brands

Understanding of A/B testing

Experience using heatmaps or CRO tools

Knowledge of upsells, bundles, subscriptions, and post-purchase funnels

Experience building advertorials or dedicated paid-traffic landing pages

Experience with beauty, supplements, consumer products, or other DTC brands

What Good Looks Like in This Role



You understand the difference between a page that looks good and a page that sells.



You naturally think about questions such as:



Is the offer immediately clear?

Is the CTA visible enough?

Does the customer understand the product within a few seconds?

Is there enough trust and social proof?

Are we addressing objections?

Is there too much information?

Does the page flow naturally toward the purchase?

Does the mobile version feel as polished as desktop?

What could we test to improve conversion?



We want someone who thinks like both a designer and a marketer.



Who You’ll Work Well With



You’ll be a strong fit if you:



Take ownership of your work

Can receive feedback without taking it personally

Communicate clearly when something is unclear

Meet deadlines consistently

Care about small design details

Enjoy e-commerce and understand what makes people buy

Are comfortable working in a fast-moving remote environment

Can research competitors and bring ideas to the table

Don’t need constant supervision

title: Part-Time Creative Strategist
description:
We're looking for a Creative Strategist to join our growing team and help develop high-converting creative concepts for paid social advertising.



This role is ideal for someone who understands what makes Meta ads perform and enjoys turning product insights into compelling ad angles, hooks, and creative briefs. You don't need to edit videos or design graphics yourself—your primary responsibility is developing the ideas that our creative team will bring to life.



What You'll Do



* Research products, competitors, and target audiences

* Develop creative angles and messaging for paid social campaigns

* Write compelling hooks, ad concepts, and creative briefs

* Generate fresh ideas for video and static ads

* Analyze winning ads and identify patterns that can be applied to new campaigns

* Collaborate with media buyers and creative tea
mbers to test and improve ad performance

* Continuously brainstorm new concepts to support scaling efforts



We're Looking For Someone Who



* Has experience with Meta 
 & Instagram) advertising

* Understands direct response marketing and consumer psychology

* Can develop creative concepts based on customer pain points and desires

* Is highly organized and able to manage multiple projects

* Has strong written English communication skills

* Takes initiative and enjoys problem-solving

* Is reliable, proactive, and easy to work with



Bonus If You Have Experience With



* DTC or eCommerce brands

* Creative strategy for paid social

* Copywriting for ads

* Reading Meta Ads performance metrics

* TikTok or other paid social platforms



Position Details

* Part-time

* Remote

* Flexible schedule (some overlap with the team may be requested)

* Opportunity for long-term growth



To Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Your experience with Meta ads or creative strategy.

3. Examples of creative briefs, ad concepts, or campaigns you've worked on (if available).

4. Your favorite DTC brand and why you think their advertising works well.

5. The word ANGLE at the beginning of your application so we know you've read the entire job post.



We're looking for someone who doesn't just generate ideas, but understands *why* certain creatives work and can consistently produce concepts that help drive performance.

title: HR Specialist - CS Recruitment & People Operations (Clark, Office-based)
description:
Full job description

About HK 24-BPO



HK 24-BPO is a fast-growing customer service outsourcing company serving cross-border e-commerce brands. We partner with Amazon and Shopify sellers across smart electronics, smart home, wearables, and audio product categories. Backed by our proprietary AI + human customer service system, we deliver reliable, high-quality support to customers around the world. We are now expanding our team and looking for a dedicated HR Specialist to join us in Clark.



About the Job



We are hiring an office-based HR Specialist in Clark, Pampanga. This is not a remote position — you will work from our office and play a key role in managing the full recruitment cycle and daily HR operations for our growing customer service team.



What You'll Do:



- Source, screen, and recruit customer service representatives across multiple channels (OnlineJobs.ph, referrals, social media, etc.)

- Manage the end-to-end hiring process — from posting job ads to scheduling interviews and onboarding new hires

- Maintain employee records, attendance tracking, and performance documentation

- Handle day-to-day HR administrative tasks and employee relations

- Coordinate with the management team in China to align hiring priorities and timelines

- Support training coordination and new hire orientation

- Build and maintain a talent pipeline for ongoing hiring needs

What You Bring:



- 1–2 years of experience in HR, recruitment, or talent acquisition

- Experience hiring for customer service or BPO roles is a strong plus

- Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal

- Highly organized with strong attention to detail

- Comfortable working with spreadsheets, job boards, and communication tools

- Self-driven and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment

- Based in or willing to relocate to Clark, Pampanga

What We Offer:



- Competitive salary: $500 – $600 per month

- Office-based position in Clark — stable, professional work environment

- Clear career growth path — grow into a senior HR role as the team scales

- Be part of a tech-driven company that combines AI with human expertise

- Hands-on experience building a team from the ground up

Availability: Full-time, office-based in Clark. Working hours to be discussed.

title: HVAC Technical Operations Coordinator – Reports, Quotes, Parts & Technician Support
description:
Job Title



HVAC Technical Operations Coordinator – Remote Role for Australian Air Conditioning Company



Employment Type



Full-time remote role

Australian business hours required

Long-term position for the right person



Company Overview



KleenAir is a growing South East Queensland air conditioning, HVAC hygiene, servicing, repairs, maintenance and installation company. We work with homeowners, tenants, property managers, real estate agencies, commercial clients, hospitality businesses and facilities managers across Brisbane, Ipswich, Logan, Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, Toowoomba and surrounding areas.



We are looking for a technically minded HVAC operations person who can support our field technicians, office team and customers by preparing professional reports, diagnosis summaries, quotes, proposals, supplier orders, parts sourcing, technician follow-ups and job completion checks.



This is not a basic virtual assistant role. We need someone with real HVAC, air conditioning or refrigeration knowledge who understands how service jobs operate, how technicians work in the field, how parts and equipment are sourced, and how to communicate technical information clearly.



About the Role



You will be a key support person between our technicians, office team, suppliers and customers.



Your role will include preparing detailed service reports, fault diagnosis reports, quotes and proposals based on technician notes, photos and findings. You will also assist with supplier calls, system orders, replacement parts sourcing, delivery coordination, stock pick-up arrangements, technician job completion checks, time logs, vehicle fleet monitoring and general technical operations support.



You must be comfortable understanding air conditioning systems, technical faults, technician notes, supplier information, parts availability, installation requirements and customer-facing recommendations.



We need someone organised, accurate, reliable and technically capable.



Key Responsibilities

1. Service Reports, Diagnosis Reports & Proposals



Prepare professional service reports based on technician notes, job photos, videos and field findings.



Prepare detailed fault diagnosis reports for split systems, ducted systems and commercial air conditioning equipment.



Write clear recommendations for repairs, maintenance, replacements or further investigation.



Prepare customer quotes for air conditioning cleaning, servicing, repairs, parts replacement and installation-related work.



Prepare proposals for property managers, real estate agencies, commercial clients, hospitality clients and facilities managers.



Review technician photos and identify what should be included in reports.



Convert rough technician notes into polished, professional and easy-to-understand language.



Prepare before-and-after summaries for HVAC hygiene jobs.



Prepare replacement recommendations where repairs are uneconomical due to system age, parts availability or repair cost.



Ensure reports are technically accurate, well-structured and suitable for homeowners, landlords, property managers and commercial clients.



2. Supplier Communication & Parts Sourcing



Call and
 suppliers to check stock availability, pricing and lead times.



Source replacement parts for air conditioning and HVAC repair jobs.



Identify and request pricing for components such as PCBs, fan motors, compressors, capacitors, sensors, thermistors, drain pumps, zone motors, dampers, filters and other HVAC parts.



Assist with organising air conditioning system orders for installations and replacements.



Arrange supplier deliveries to job sites, office, warehouse or technician pick-up locations.



Coordinate stock pick-ups and make sure technicians know where and when parts or systems are available.



Follow up suppliers when pricing, parts confirmations or delivery updates are delayed.



Keep the office team updated on parts availability, delays and expected delivery times.



Maintain clear records of supplier pricing, purchase details, expected delivery dates and job allocation.



3. Technician Job Coordination & Quality Follow-Up



Monitor scheduled jobs and check that technicians are completing work as per the job scope.



Review job notes, photos and completion details to ensure work has been properly documented.



Follow up technicians when information is missing, unclear or incomplete.



Check whether required photos have been uploaded before reports are prepared.



Help ensure technicians are completing jobs to company quality standards.



Assist the office team in identifying jobs that need follow-up, return visits, quoting or escalation.



Help make sure customers and property managers receive accurate updates after technical jobs.



Support technicians with job details, supplier information, parts updates and documentation requirements.



4. Time Logs, Job Tracking & Fleet Monitoring



Maintain technician time logs based on job schedules, field updates and vehicle tracking information.



Check technician start times, finish times, travel time and job completion times where required.



Assist with monitoring technician productivity and daily job progress.



Review vehicle fleet movements where required to support time log accuracy and job tracking.



Identify delays, gaps or inconsistencies between scheduled works, technician updates and actual job progress.



Help the management team understand technician workload, daily output and job completion status.



Support scheduling improvements by identifying where jobs are taking longer than expected or where routing/logistics can be improved.



5. General Operations Support



Work closely with the office team, technicians and management to keep jobs moving smoothly.



Help keep job records, reports, quotes and supplier updates organised.



Assist with internal process improvement around technical reporting, quoting, stock control and technician coordination.



Follow company templates, wording, quality standards and reporting processes.



Ask clear questions when technician notes or supplier details are incomplete.



Help maintain consistency across reports, quotes, proposals and customer communication.



Required Experience



Strong background in HVAC, air conditioning, refrigeration, mechanical services, building services or HVAC operations.



Previous experience as an HVAC technician, refrigeration technician, HVAC service coordinator, HVAC admin support, dispatcher, estimator, technical report writer, maintenance coordinator, parts coordinator or similar.



Strong understanding of split systems and ducted air conditioning systems.



Ability to understand common AC faults and explain them professionally.



Ability to read technician notes and photos and turn them into clear customer-facing reports.



Experience dealing with suppliers, checking parts availability or coordinating equipment orders.



Strong written and spoken English.



High attention to detail.



Ability to work independently without needing constant supervision.



Good computer skills and ability to work with online systems, cloud documents, CRM software, job management tools and spreadsheets.



Reliable internet connection and quiet working environment.



Highly Valued Skills



Experience working with an Australian, New Zealand, UK, US or similar HVAC company.



Knowledge of Australian air conditioning terminology, supplier processes and customer expectations.



Experience preparing quotes, diagnosis reports, maintenance reports, repair proposals or insurance-style reports.



Experience coordinating technicians, job schedules, parts, stock, deliveries or supplier orders.



Understanding of property management workflows.



Knowledge of HVAC hygiene, mould contamination, coil cleaning, ducted systems, air movement and indoor air quality.



Ability to use AI tools carefully to improve writing while still applying real HVAC knowledge.



Experience with ServiceM8, Simpro, Tradify, Fergus, FieldPulse, Jobber, ServiceTitan, 
, CRMs, Google Workspace or similar systems.



Technical Knowledge We Are Looking For



You should be comfortable understanding and writing about:



Split system indoor and outdoor units

Ducted air conditioning systems

Evaporator coils and condenser coils

Blocked drains and drain pumps

Refrigerant leaks and pressure-related concerns

Compressor faults

Outdoor PCB faults

Indoor PCB faults

Fan motor faults

Thermistors and sensors

Capacitors

Zone motors and dampers

Airflow issues

Dirty filters and poor maintenance

Mould and microbial contamination inside AC systems

Condensation leaks

System age and replacement recommendations

Parts availability and repair feasibility

Electrical isolation and safety considerations

Preventative maintenance recommendations

Repair versus replacement recommendations



You do not need to physically diagnose systems yourself, but you must understand enough HVAC terminology and service logic to support the field team properly.



Who This Role Is Not For



Please do not apply if you are only a general virtual assistant with no HVAC, air conditioning, refrigeration or mechanical services experience.



Please do not apply if you cannot understand technical job notes.



Please do not apply if you are uncomfortable calling suppliers or following up technicians.



Please do not apply if you rely only on AI to write technical reports without understanding the HVAC issue.



Please do not apply if you need to be told every small step throughout the day.



We need someone who is technically capable, organised, reliable, detail-focused and able to think.



Working Style



Remote work from home.



You will be working with an Australian company, so strong communication and reliability are essential.



Australian business hours are required.



You must be comfortable making phone calls to suppliers when required.



You must be comfortable asking technicians clear questions when information is missing.



You must be able to follow company templates, reporting standards and tone of voice.



You must be able to prepare reports and quotes that sound professional, trustworthy and technically sound.



You must care about accuracy. These reports and quotes are sent to real customers, property managers, landlords and commercial clients.



Example Tasks



Prepare a diagnosis report from technician notes and photos.



Prepare a repair quote after a technician identifies a suspected faulty fan motor, PCB, sensor, drain issue or compressor-related concern.



Call a supplier to check price and availability for a replacement PCB or fan motor.



Arrange delivery or pick-up of a new air conditioning system for an installation job.



Follow up a technician because job photos or fault notes are incomplete.



Check whether a technician completed all scheduled works for the day.



Review vehicle tracking and job times to help maintain technician time logs.



Prepare a recommendation explaining why an older system may not be economical to repair.



Prepare a ducted system maintenance proposal for a property manager.



Prepare a split AC hygiene report showing contamination, cleaning work completed and future maintenance recommendations.



Prepare a commercial client proposal for scheduled maintenance or hygiene works.



Update the office team about supplier delays, parts availability or technician job progress.



Personal Qualities We Want



Technically minded

Excellent written and spoken English

Confident calling suppliers

Organised and structured

Honest and reliable

Fast learner

Strong attention to detail

Self-motivated

Calm under pressure

Able to work with minimal supervision

Good at following up people politely but firmly

Proud of producing high-quality work

Comfortable working in a growing business where systems continue to improve



Training



We will provide training on our company templates, service categories, reporting style, quote structure, supplier processes, technician workflows and internal systems.



However, we are specifically looking for someone who already has real HVAC, air conditioning, refrigeration or mechanical services knowledge. We can train you on our systems, but we cannot train a complete beginner from scratch for this role.



Compensation



Competitive monthly salary based on experience, HVAC knowledge, English quality, supplier coordination ability and overall operations experience.



There is long-term growth potential for the right person as our company expands into more HVAC services, commercial maintenance, property management work, mould remediation, restoration and technical proposal work.



How to Apply



Please send your application with the following:



Your HVAC, air conditioning, refrigeration or mechanical services experience.

Your experience preparing reports, quotes, proposals or technical documentation.

Your experience calling suppliers, sourcing parts, arranging deliveries or coordinating technicians.

The types of AC systems you understand best.

Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

Your internet speed and available working hours.

Your experience with job management systems, CRMs, Google Workspace or spreadsheets.

A short explanation of why you would be suitable for this role.



Applications that do not mention HVAC, air conditioning, refrigeration, supplier coordination or technical operations experience will not be prioritised.



Screening Questions



Please answer these questions in your application:



What is your experience with HVAC, air conditioning or refrigeration?

Have you worked with an Australian, New Zealand, UK, US or similar trade/service company before?

What is the difference between a split system and a ducted air conditioning system?

What are common reasons an AC system may leak water indoors?

What does a PCB do in an air conditioning system?

What parts would you commonly need to source for an AC repair job?

Have you called suppliers before to check parts, pricing or stock availability?

Have you coordinated technicians, job schedules, deliveries or stock pick-ups before?

Are you comfortable following up technicians if job notes or photos are incomplete?

Are you comfortable maintaining technician time logs and checking job progress?

If a system is old and repair parts are expensive or hard to source, how would you explain the repair-versus-replacement recommendation to a customer?

Have you prepared service reports, diagnosis reports, maintenance proposals or repair quotes before?

Are you available to work during Australian business hours?

Trial Task



Shortlisted applicants may be given a small test task where we provide sample technician notes, job photos and supplier information. You may be asked to prepare a short HVAC diagnosis report, quote recommendation and supplier follow-up summary.



We are looking for someone long-term who can become a key technical operations support person in our business.

This is not a first-line technical support role. You will own the customer relationship and commercial outcome, coordinating closely with Support and Product when necessary.



What You’ll Do

Act as the main point of contact for your assigned customers.

Onboard new customers and help them activate and adopt Revyoos effectively.

Run product demos, training sessions and screen-sharing calls when relevant.

Help customers make the most of Revyoos features, including review widgets, Reputation and SEO Pages, Sentiment Analytics, AI Visibility, AI review responses and OTA connections.

Identify customers who are underusing the platform and create practical actions to improve adoption.

Monitor customer health, identify churn risks and take action to retain at-risk accounts.

Identify, qualify and close relevant upgrades, plan changes and expansion opportunities.

Organise and host customer webinars to present product updates, use cases and best practices.

Create targeted outreach initiatives based on product usage, customer needs and growth opportunities.

Collect structured customer feedback and share relevant insights with the Product team.

Work closely with Sales, Support and Product to ensure customers receive the right help and opportunities at the right time.

Keep customer information, follow-up tasks, calls and account activity accurate and up to date in Zoho CRM.

Bring forward practical ideas to improve customer engagement, retention and account growth.

What We’re Looking For

Based in the Philippines.

3+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Onboarding or another commercial customer-facing role.

Experience managing a large portfolio of B2B customers, ideally 100+ accounts.

Proven ability to improve activation, retention, customer engagement or account growth.

SaaS experience is strongly preferred.

Experience in vacation rentals, hospitality, hotel technology, PMS, revenue management or property management is a strong advantage.

Comfortable speaking with customers, running video calls, delivering product demos and presenting online sessions.

Commercially minded and confident discussing product value, plans, upgrades and pricing without being pushy.

Highly organised, with strong CRM discipline and the ability to manage calls, follow-ups and multiple customer priorities.

Independent, proactive and comfortable working remotely as part of an international team.

Fluent spoken and written English.

Spanish is a strong plus.

What Success Looks Like



You will be successful if you can:



Build trusted, long-term relationships with customers.

Improve customer activation and adoption of key Revyoos features.

Reduce preventable churn and recover at-risk accounts.

Generate meaningful expansion through upgrades and account growth.

Identify the right customer opportunities and act on them at the right time.

Maintain a reliable view of customer activity and account health in the CRM.

Turn customer feedback into useful input for our Product, Sales and Support teams.

Compensation

900$ +  Performance-based variable compensation linked to customer retention, activation, account growth and directly generated expansion revenue.

The Profile We’re Looking For



You are not a reactive support agent and you are not a salesperson focused only on closing new business.



You understand that customer success, retention and expansion are connected. You can run strong customer conversations, explain product value clearly, manage a large portfolio with discipline and take ownership of outcomes.



You are proactive without being pushy, commercial without being aggressive, and motivated by helping customers succeed while contributing directly to Revyoos’ growth.

title: PERFORMANCE VIDEO EDITOR
description:
Performance Video Editor

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $10–20 USD/hour depending on experience + uncapped performance bonuses

About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce travel jewelry brands in the US. We sell collectible country charms for travelers, with new products launching soon. Our content machine has generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram.

This role is video, end-to-end. You'll concept and cut short-form video ads for paid media across TikTok, Reels, and Meta placements, where every edit is judged on what it does to hook rate, retention, and spend. You're not making brand films or organic filler. You're making the creative we put budget behind.

We're looking for an editor who can own their output and be creative within proven marketing fundamentals, not just execute tasks. This is not a gig; it's a long-term partnership. Many of our editors have been with us 2+ years, and the people who now set our creative direction started as editors here.

You'll work closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. We're a small, high-output team that moves fast, communicates daily, and invests in the people who show up.

Where You'll Be in Six Months

Senior Performance Video Editor.

That's the next title, and it's within reach inside your first six months if your work earns it. At that level you have full creative autonomy: you own video concepts end to end, you d
 which angles we test next instead of receiving briefs, your creatives are the ones we put real spend behind, and you start reviewing other editors' cuts and shaping how they work.

It's d
 by performance, not time served. Move faster if your work moves faster.

Compensation & Earning Potential

Base: $10–20 USD/hour depending on experience

Performance bonuses: Uncapped, paid per winning creative. Every video that hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid ads pays out.

Rate reviews: Revisited as you take on more, not on an annual calendar

Our top editors earn meaningfully more than their base because they produce winners consistently. That's the whole design: we'd rather pay a lot for creatives that work than a little for creatives that don't.

What Success Looks Like

After 3–6 months, a successful hire is consistently producing short-form video ads that scale on paid and perform organically, hitting 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates, and iterating on winning formats without needing direction from the marketing team. You'll be a trusted creative partner, not just an executor.

Core Responsibilities

Concept and edit short-form video ads for TikTok, Reels, and Meta, built around hook rate, retention, and watch time rather than aesthetics

Develop new video angles and hooks, then test them against our proven formats

Build AI-assisted video creative using current tools, and keep pace as those tools change

Review your past edits daily, identify what's working and what isn't, and improve without repeating mistakes

Work directly from paid performance data to d
 what to cut next

Turn around content quickly and communicate proactively every day, with no check-ins required

Stay on top of TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where they'll actually convert

Must-Haves

A strong recent portfolio of short-form video edits, ideally including paid ad creative (20+ from the last few months)

You can watch a winning video ad and break down exactly what made it work

Hands-on experience across video formats: hook-led headline videos, talking heads, voiceovers, UGC-style edits, AI video

Ability to read metrics (hook rate, retention, watch time, spend) and know what to change in the next cut

Takes ownership, internalizes feedback, doesn't repeat the same mistake twice

Highly skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool

Strong written and spoken English; able to work independently

Nice-to-Haves

Experience cutting video ads for e-commerce or DTC brands

Experience working directly against Meta or TikTok ad account data

A track record of creatives that scaled on paid

What You'll Learn Here

Most editing jobs teach you software. This one teaches you why video sells.

Direct access to paid performance data on real ad spend, so you see exactly which of your creatives print and which die

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Paid courses and software, including the AI video tools you'll be working in

A portfolio backed by numbers, not vibes. "This cut did 4M views and scaled to $X/day" is a career asset that follows you.

Not a Fit If

Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content

You can't point to a recent video ad and explain why it performed

You want to make beautiful videos more than videos that sell

You need a fixed schedule or close supervision to stay productive

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

Working Style

Engagement: Independent contractor, paid in USD

Location: 100% remote

Hours: ~40 hrs/week, long-term role

Schedule: Fully flexible. Work whenever you want, as long as you turn work around quickly and communicate daily (async). No timezone overlap required.

Time off: Flexible PTO. Take the time you need, just coordinate with the team.

Tools: CapCut Pro (or comparable), AI video tools, TikTok/Meta analytics

Working style: No micromanagement

How to Apply

It takes about 5 minutes. We review every application.

title: E-commerce Marketplace, Fulfilment & Growth Specialist.
description:
HIRING: E-commerce Marketplace, Fulfilment & Growth Specialist

Remote – Philippines



We are building and expanding an e-commerce business selling motorcycle and adventure products in the Philippines, with planned expansion into Australia.



We need an experienced, organised e-commerce specialist who can help establish our stores correctly, manage product listings and support future international growth.



Main responsibilities



Philippine marketplaces:



* Create and upload complete product listings to Lazada, Shopee and TikTok Shop

* Correctly configure SKUs, categories, attributes, variations, pricing, dimensions and stock quantities

* Write professional titles, descriptions and product specifications

* Connect and map marketplace SKUs with our 3PL warehouse-management system

* Add future products and maintain existing listings

* Monitor stock, orders, listing errors and inventory synchronisation

* Help manage promotions, vouchers and marketplace campaigns



Shopify, eBay and Australian expansion:



* Strong experience building and managing Shopify stores

* Help establish Australian-facing Shopify websites and domains

* Create and manage eBay listings

* Configure products for direct fulfilment from Fulfillmen or other overseas 3PL warehouses

* Understand international inventory, shipping, tracking, returns and order-routing workflows

* Help expand products into additional countries and sales channels



3PL and logistics experience:



* Experience working with 3PL fulfilment companies and warehouse-management systems

* Experience connecting marketplaces and Shopify stores to fulfilment providers

* Knowledge of sea-road freight solutions from China to the Philippines or Australia

* Ability to coordinate product information, carton data, SKUs and inbound shipments with suppliers and warehouses

* Fulfillmen experience is highly desirable



Images, advertisements and content:



* Use AI and professional editing platforms to create high-quality product images

* Produce listing images, infographics, feature images, advertisements and promotional content

* Remove or translate Chinese text from supplier images

* Create clean, professional, platform-compliant product presentations

* Experience with Canva, Adobe tools or comparable AI image-editing platforms



Marketing and sales funnels:



* Experience with Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Google Ads or marketplace advertising

* Create campaigns designed to funnel traffic into our stores and product listings

* Set up retargeting, promotions and basic sales funnels

* Monitor results and recommend improvements based on advertising performance

* Help improve conversion rates rather than simply increasing traffic



Product research and sourcing:



* Identify trending and potentially profitable products

* Research marketplace demand, competition, pricing and likely margins

* Recommend products suitable for the Philippines and Australian markets

* Help us locate suitable products and suppliers in China

* Organise the information required to obtain quotations and send products directly to our fulfilment warehouses



Required experience



Applicants must have genuine hands-on experience in several of the following:



* Lazada Seller Center

* Shopee Seller Centre

* TikTok Shop Seller Center

* Shopify

* eBay

* 3PL and WMS integrations

* Fulfillmen or similar international fulfilment providers

* Product and SKU management

* E-commerce image creation

* Paid advertising and sales funnels

* China product research and sourcing



This is not a general virtual-assistant or basic data-entry position. We need someone who understands how products, marketplaces, inventory, warehouses, advertising and international fulfilment work together.



How to apply



Please provide:



1. A summary of your relevant experience.

2. The marketplaces and platforms you have personally managed.

Please begin your application with the words “ADVENTURE MOTO” so we know you read the complete advertisement.



Shortlisted applicants will receive a paid practical test involving one motorcycle-accessory product. The test will assess listing preparation, SKU accuracy, image presentation, product research and marketplace knowledge.

title: Executive Assistant  for Business Operations & Growth Support
description:
We're an Australian property investment business launching several new ventures — including an online education platform and a drop-shipping curtain business — alongside our core operations. We're looking for a strong, capable operator who can take true end-to-end ownership: setting up a business from scratch and then running it day-to-day once live.



This is not an admin or support role. You'll be the person who builds how a business works — systems, processes, structure — and then keeps it running well. If one venture doesn't fill your time, you may take on more than one.



This is a full-time role, starting part-time for the first few months.



What you'll be doing

- Setting up new business ventures — it's systems, structure, and operations

- Running ventures day-to-day once they're operational

- Building and managing teams where needed as ventures grow

- Establishing processes so each business operates smoothly without constant oversight

- Identifying and solving operational problems before they become blockers

- Reporting progress and flagging issues that need attention

- Taking on new ventures or projects as they come up — scoping and launching each one

- Bringing structure to ambiguous, early-stage situations



Who we're looking for

You may be a strong fit if you:

- Have experience setting up a business, department, or venture from scratch — not just running an existing one

- Have experience managing or coordinating teams

- Are comfortable operating with real autonomy and minimal day-to-day direction

- Can make sound decisions independently and follow through without being chased

- Communicate clearly and professionally in written and spoken English

- Are a strategic thinker who is also structured and detail-oriented in execution

- Can juggle multiple ventures or priorities at once



Experience in online education, real estate, buyers agency, or ecommerce is a strong plus — but we're primarily looking for a proven operator who can figure things out, regardless of specific industry background.



What success looks like

- New ventures move from idea to fully operational

- Once live, each venture runs smoothly with minimal oversight required

- Problems get identified and solved before they escalate

Rolling Canvas is a premium South Asian wedding photography and videography studio based in Sydney, Australia. Our films are known for a natural, editorial aesthetic that prioritises emotion over flash. We are looking for a dedicated colorist to join our post production team remotely.



What you will work on



You will colour grade three types of deliverable. Highlight videos run five to seven minutes. Reels run up to one minute. Feature films run 25 to 35 minutes. All content is wedding footage shot across multiple cameras that needs matching, grading, and a consistent final look.



What we are looking for



You are a trained colorist, not a general video editor who also does colour. You have spent real time learning colour theory, camera matching and grading workflow, and you know DaVinci Resolve well. Premiere Pro experience is a bonus.



You have a portfolio of wedding or film colour work you can show us. You are available for ongoing work, not one-off gigs. You understand that a premium client expects a premium deliverable and you take quality seriously.



The style we work in



Our aesthetic is natural, warm, and desaturated. We do not do heavy stylised looks. Camera matching across multiple angles is a core part of the job. You need to be comfortable working from a style reference and reproducing it consistently across a full wedding day.



What the workflow looks like



You receive edited prores file via Dropbox. You deliver graded files within the agreed turnaround. You communicate via WhatsApp or
. You flag issues early, not after a deadline.



What we pay



We are open to per project rates or a monthly retainer depending on volume. Please include your rate and a link to your portfolio when you apply.



How to apply



Send your portfolio, your rate, and a short note on your colour background. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.

HOW much we should spend acquiring them.

HOW we bring them back if they don't purchase.

HOW we turn first-time customers into repeat customers.

WHETHER the marketing actually made money.



Our objective is not followers.

Our objective is profitable growth.



YOUR MISSION

Build a sophisticated digital customer-acquisition and retention engine capable of helping scale our company toward $10+ million in annual revenue.



We are a wholesale bakery looking to create and execute a lead generation campaign for corporate orders including event planners, executive assistants, brand managers, gifting platforms, holiday gifts, employee appreciation etc.

title: Partnerships Coordinator
description:
UK luxury concierge. We arrange staffed villas, yachts, private jets, restaurants, clubs and venues. Villa stock for some destinations is already live. This role is soft first contact with new suppliers and venues, and first replies to client
s, then you flag the owner when a decision or a proper reply is needed.



What “soft first contact” means



You introduce us, ask the right questions, and log the conversation. You do not invent prices, confirm availability, or close a booking. If they ask for a rate, a contract, or a yes/no, you message the owner with a 5-line brief and wait.



You will cover (all of these, by
/WhatsApp)

Villas/chalets — operators and local agencies in destinations that are not yet stocked (e.g. Saint-Tropez, Cannes, Marbella, Courchevel, Bodrum)

Yachts — charter brokers and fleet desks (Med: St-Tropez, Monaco, Ibiza, Mykonos)

Jets / helicopters — charter brokers and operators (empty-leg and on-request)

Restaurants — hard-to-book rooms, membership desks, reservations managers

Venues — clubs, beach clubs, table programmes in cities already on our site



Day to day

Find the right person (partnerships, reservations, charter desk, table manager)

Send a short, professional first
 or WhatsApp from our company name

Log every contact in a spreadsheet: type (villa / yacht / jet / restaurant / venue), name, status, next step

First-reply to client enquiries using our scripts (what they want, dates, party size). Then tag the owner

Once a week: a short list of content ideas from competitor accounts (you do not post live until we say so)





You must already have

Worked in at least one of: travel agency, DMC, villa reservations, yacht charter desk, private aviation broker assistant, hotel/restaurant reservations, or luxury concierge/partnerships. You must be used to
ing businesses, not only chatting to customers.



Excellent written English (UK/US/)



To apply: CV + which desk you worked on + 5–8 lines: how you would make first contact with (a) a Saint-Tropez villa operator and (b) a Mayfair or Monaco restaurant/venue, and when you would hand it to the owner.

title: Shopify Store Builder
description:
Shopify Store Builder — Full Time, Long Term



I run several e-commerce brands and launch new stores regularly. I need one person to build them.



I'll send you the brief — product, niche, reference stores, the look I want. You build it. Then you send it back finished, not 80% done.



Your daily work:



Build complete Shopify stores from scratch — theme setup, homepage, product pages, collections, policies, checkout flow

Rebuild or clone layouts I send you as references, matching the design closely

Product page work: variants, bundles, badges, upsells, trust elements, mobile view

Product and competitor research — find winning products, save ad creatives, document what competitors are doing

Create simple creatives and product images using AI tools

Fix, polish, and QA stores before launch



Requirements:



3–5 years in e-commerce / dropshipping. You have built real stores that made real sales

Strong Shopify skill — you know themes, sections, apps, and can solve problems without asking me every step. Liquid/HTML/CSS is a big plus

You use AI tools daily and work fast because of it

Good written English

Full time, overlapping with European hours (GMT+2)

You finish things. If something is unclear you ask once, then you deliver



Offer:



$5/hour, full time, paid every two weeks

Long term position — I want the same person here in two years

Salary increases based on results, not time. Deliver clean work fast and the rate goes up

Steady work, no dry months. There is always another store to build



Not for you if: you need step-by-step supervision, you've only done Shopify in a course, or you disappear for days.



To apply, send:



Links to 3 Shopify stores you personally built. Say what you did on each

How long you've been in e-commerce and what your last role was

Which AI tools you use and for what

Your available hours in GMT+2

Start your message with "Serpent" — messages without it are deleted

title: Australian HR & Talent Acquisition Manager – Trades & Field Services
description:
Colby Pty Ltd is a growing Australian business based in Adelaide, South Australia, operating across field services, pool servicing and technology.



We are looking for an experienced Australian HR & Talent Acquisition Manager to become our first dedicated HR/People hire.



Please only apply if you have previous practical experience working with Australian employees and Australian HR/employment requirements. General international recruitment experience alone is not sufficient for this position.



This is not simply a recruitment position.



Initially, a major priority will be helping us solve a difficult recruitment problem: identifying, headhunting and hiring high-quality technicians and field-service employees in Australia.



However, the longer-term responsibility is much broader.



We want someone capable of building our HR and People function from the ground up and eventually taking ownership of recruitment, onboarding, employee administration, performance management, training coordination, retention and workforce planning.



The person we are looking for



We are specifically looking for someone who has previous experience working with an Australian business and Australian employees.



Ideally, you have worked within an Australian:



trades or field-service business

construction or maintenance company

labour-hire/recruitment business

HVAC, electrical, plumbing or mechanical-services company

facilities-management business

industrial or technical-services company

mining/services organisation

or another business employing Australian field workers or tradespeople



Experience recruiting Australian tradespeople or technicians will be highly regarded.



Your initial priorities



Your first major responsibility will be helping us recruit technicians in Adelaide.



Traditional job advertisements alone have not produced the quality of candidates we need.



You will therefore be expected to proactively identify and approach employed candidates from relevant and adjacent industries, including:



pool servicing

pumps

irrigation

water treatment

HVAC

electrical/mechanical service

facilities maintenance

pest control

landscaping/turf

appliance/service technicians

industrial field service

other mechanically minded field-service occupations



You should be comfortable with headhunting and passive candidate sourcing, not simply posting job advertisements and waiting for applications.



This may include LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean/X-Ray searching, competitor and target-company mapping, industry research, referrals, databases, direct outreach and other sourcing methods.



Building our HR function



Once you understand the business, we want you to progressively establish a practical HR framework suitable for a growing Australian SME.



Responsibilities may include:



Recruitment

Workforce planning and vacancy management

Job descriptions and advertisements

Passive candidate sourcing and headhunting

Candidate screening and interviewing

Interview scorecards and assessment processes

Reference checking

Maintaining candidate pipelines and talent databases

Recruitment reporting and metrics

Australian HR administration

Employee records and HR documentation

Employment contract administration

Position descriptions

Onboarding and offboarding

Probation processes

Leave and employee documentation

Maintaining appropriate HR systems and records

Coordination with payroll/administration where required

Performance & employee development

30/60/90-day reviews

Performance-review systems

KPI frameworks

Performance improvement processes

Employee feedback and development

Retention initiatives

Exit interviews

Identifying recurring employee or management issues

Training



We are developing a structured technician training program.



You will help integrate this into the employee lifecycle through:



onboarding

training records

competency tracking

supervisor/trainer feedback

probation reviews

training progress reporting

ongoing employee development

HR systems and policies



Over time, we want you to help establish and maintain appropriate:



HR policies

employee handbook/process documentation

onboarding procedures

performance-management processes

employee databases

HR reporting

organisational charts

role descriptions

workforce planning

retention and succession processes



We are a growing small business, so we are looking for practical systems rather than unnecessary corporate bureaucracy.



Australian HR knowledge is important



This is an important part of the position.



You should already have practical exposure to the Australian employment environment.



We are particularly interested in candidates familiar with areas such as:



Fair Work

National Employment Standards

Modern Awards

employment classifications

employment contracts

probation

leave entitlements

hours of work

overtime and allowances

performance management

disciplinary processes

termination/offboarding

contractor versus employee considerations



You are not expected to act as an Australian employment lawyer, and specialist legal advice will be obtained where required.



However, we do not want to teach our HR Manager the Australian employment system from the beginning.



You should already understand how Australian HR operates and know when something requires specialist advice.



What we're looking for

Essential

Strong professional HR and recruitment experience

Previous experience supporting Australian employees or an Australian business

Practical understanding of Australian HR/employment practices

Experience working with Australian employment contracts and HR documentation

Proven end-to-end recruitment experience

Strong proactive/passive candidate sourcing ability

Experience with LinkedIn, Boolean searching or similar sourcing techniques

Experience building or improving HR processes

Strong written and spoken English

Excellent organisation and documentation

Ability to work independently

Confidence working directly with the business owner

Highly desirable

Australian trades, blue-collar or field-service recruitment

Experience recruiting technicians

Experience working for an Australian SME

Experience establishing an HR function from an early stage

Modern Award experience

Employee relations experience

Performance-management experience

HRIS/ATS implementation

Training and competency-management experience

This role may suit you if...



You are currently an:



HR Manager

People & Culture Manager

HR Generalist

HR Business Partner

Talent Acquisition & HR Manager

People Operations Manager

Recruitment Manager



who has worked extensively with Australian businesses and now wants the opportunity to take ownership of an entire People function rather than simply perform one small part of HR.



What success looks like



Within your first months, we would expect you to:



understand our workforce and hiring requirements

build a structured recruitment pipeline

develop target-company lists for technician recruitment

proactively identify Australian field-service candidates

establish organised HR records and processes

improve onboarding

establish probation and employee-review systems

integrate our technician training program with HR

identify gaps in our current HR processes

progressively build a practical HR framework for the business



Over time, we want you to become the person the owner can rely on to say:



“Leave the People and HR side with me.”



Application questions



I’d also replace the existing application questions with these, because these will filter people much harder before you ever waste time interviewing them:



How many years have you worked in HR and recruitment?

Have you personally supported employees physically working in Australia?

Explain the company, industry, approximate number of employees and what HR responsibilities you personally handled.

Which Australian trades, technicians, blue-collar or field-service roles have you personally recruited?

Please list specific job titles.

Which Australian Modern Awards have you worked with?

If none, please state this clearly.

Describe your practical experience with Fair Work, the NES, employment classifications, leave, probation, ove
, performance management and termination.

Have you personally prepared, administered or reviewed Australian employment contracts?

Explain what responsibility you had.

Tell us about an HR function, process or system that you personally built from scratch.

What existed before you started, what did you personally create, and what was the result?

Imagine we need an experienced irrigation or field-service technician in Adelaide who has been with their current employer for at least three years. How would you identify and approach passive candidates?

Provide an example Boolean/X-Ray search you could use to identify relevant Adelaide technicians.

Tell us about one difficult Australian vacancy you personally filled.

What made it difficult, where did you find the successful candidate, and were they actively looking for work?

Which HRIS, ATS, recruitment and sourcing platforms have you personally used?

What hourly rate in USD are you seeking for a full-time long-term position?
