title: Short-Term Rental Operations Virtual Assistant
description:
About Us



We’re a Melbourne-based, family-run short-term rental and property management business managing a growing portfolio of high-quality homes and apartments.



Our focus is not simply on managing bookings. We aim to operate properties professionally, maximise their performance, provide an excellent experience for guests and owners, and build systems that allow our portfolio to grow without sacrificing quality.



We place a high value on fast communication, attention to detail, clear processes, commercial thinking, and people who take genuine ownership of their responsibilities.



You’ll be joining a close-knit team of six people, made up of three team members based locally in Melbourne and three Virtual Assistants in the Philippines. You will be working closely with both the Melbourne team and the other VAs, with responsibilities shared across guest operations, property performance, owner communication, cleaning coordination, listings, pricing, onboarding, and administration.



This is intended to be a long-term position with opportunities to take on greater responsibility as the business grows.



Role Overview



We’re looking for someone who already understands the short-term rental industry and can become an important part of our day-to-day operations team.



Previous experience working in short-term rental management is highly preferred. This may include working directly for a short-term rental/property management company or previously working as a Virtual Assistant supporting an Airbnb or short-term rental management business.



Because of the nature of the position, we’re particularly interested in candidates who already understand concepts such as guest communication, turnovers, cleaning coordination, property issues, Airbnb and 
 listings, calendar management, owner expectations, and the fast-moving nature of short-term accommodation.



The position will begin with a strong focus on guest communication and daily operations, but it is designed to develop well beyond guest messaging.



As you become confident with our portfolio and systems, you will become increasingly involved in:



Guest and reservation management

Pricing and revenue optimisation

Listing optimisation

Owner communication

Property onboarding

Cleaning and turnover coordination

Maintenance coordination

Property performance reviews

Administrative and bookkeeping support

New business and portfolio growth



We are looking for someone who wants to understand why we do things, not simply complete tasks from a checklist.



Over time, there will be opportunities to take ownership of areas of the business, help improve our systems, train future team members, and develop into a more senior operations or portfolio management position.



Working Hours



This is a full-time position working 5 days per week, with Thursday and Friday off.



**Monday**

Melbourne Time: 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM

Philippines Time: 5:00 AM – 1:30 PM



**Tuesday**

Melbourne Time: 3:00 PM – 11:30 PM

Philippines Time: 1:00 PM – 9:30 PM



**Wednesday**

Melbourne Time: 3:00 PM – 11:30 PM

Philippines Time: 1:00 PM – 9:30 PM



**Thursday**

Melbourne Time: OFF

Philippines Time: OFF



**Friday**

Melbourne Time: OFF

Philippines Time: OFF



**Saturday**

Melbourne Time: 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM

Philippines Time: 5:00 AM – 1:30 PM



**Sunday**

Melbourne Time: 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM

Philippines Time: 5:00 AM – 1:30 PM



**Working Days:** Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday

**Days Off:** Thursday and Friday



Because this role supports live short-term rental operations, reliability and availability during these rostered hours are essential.



Key Responsibilities

1. Guest Messaging & Reservation Operations



You will help manage communication throughout the complete guest journey, including pre-booking, pre-arrival, in-stay, checkout, and post-stay communication.



Responsibilities will include:



Responding to guest messages across Airbnb, 
, VRBO, and other booking channels

Answering pre-booking enquiries and helping convert suitable enquiries into reservations

Sending and checking arrival, access, check-in, and checkout information

Managing common guest requests such as early check-in, late checkout, parking questions, date changes, additional guests, lost property, and property-specific questions

Troubleshooting access issues and common property problems

Identifying urgent situations and escalating them quickly

Coordinating with cleaners, maintenance contractors, and Melbourne-based team members when required

Managing noise complaints, lockouts, urgent maintenance issues, and other time-sensitive situations in accordance with our procedures

Maintaining accurate reservation notes and internal records

Following up on outstanding guest issues until they are resolved

Identifying potential guest experience issues before they develop into complaints or poor reviews



The goal is not simply to respond quickly. We expect communication to be clear, thoughtful, professional, and solution-focused.



2. Pricing & Revenue Optimisation



A significant part of the role will develop into pricing optimisation and revenue management across our portfolio.



You will work with the team to ensure that our properties are competitively positioned and that pricing reflects demand, seasonality, booking pace, events, occupancy, and market conditions.



Responsibilities may include:



Reviewing property pricing regularly

Monitoring future occupancy and booking pace

Identifying dates where pricing may be too high or too low

Reviewing minimum-night requirements and length-of-stay restrictions

Adjusting rates and calendar strategies based on demand

Monitoring upcoming Melbourne events, holidays, school holidays, concerts, sporting events, and other demand drivers

Reviewing gaps between reservations and identifying opportunities to increase occupancy

Monitoring short-notice availability

Comparing our properties against relevant competing listings

Identifying underperforming periods

Supporting last-minute pricing strategies

Reviewing longer-term forward occupancy

Helping maximise revenue without unnecessarily discounting properties

Reviewing the performance of pricing changes and learning from the results



Depending on experience, you may work with dynamic pricing software and our property management/channel management systems.



Training will be provided around our strategy, but we are particularly interested in someone who enjoys working with numbers, patterns, and commercial decisions.



3. Listing Optimisation



You will also help ensure that our listings are continually improving rather than simply being created once and forgotten.



Listing optimisation will include:



Reviewing Airbnb, 
, VRBO, and other listings for accuracy

Improving listing titles and descriptions

Strengthening the first sections of listings to communicate key selling points

Reviewing photo sequencing and identifying photography improvements

Ensuring amenities are correctly selected and displayed

Updating property information when features or facilities change

Improving house rules and guest expectations

Updating check-in information

Maintaining digital guidebooks

Reviewing competitor listings

Identifying opportunities to differentiate our properties

Reviewing guest questions and feedback to identify information that should be added to listings

Monitoring listing quality and completeness

Helping improve conversion from listing views to bookings



We want someone who can eventually look at a property listing and ask:



What can we change to make this property perform better?



4. Owner Communication



As you become familiar with our properties and systems, you will increasingly assist with owner communication.



This can include:



Responding to routine owner questions

Providing updates regarding maintenance and property issues

Requesting approval for repairs, purchases, or improvements

Following up on outstanding owner decisions

Communicating recommendations for property improvements

Providing updates regarding guest i
 where appropriate

Helping explain operational decisions

Maintaining clear records of owner approvals and instructions

Assisting with property performance discussions



Our owners trust us with valuable assets, so communication needs to be professional, accurate, timely, and well documented.



5. New Property Onboarding



You will help take newly signed properties from initial handover through to being ready to accept their first guests.



This includes following our onboarding systems and ensuring that no important details are missed.



Responsibilities may include collecting and documenting:



Property access information

Wi-Fi information

Parking instructions

Building access procedures

Rubbish and recycling instructions

Appliance instructions

Heating and cooling information

Linen requirements

Bedding configurations

Property inventory

House rules

Emergency information

Owner preferences

Maintenance contacts

Local recommendations



You may also assist with:



Building Airbnb and other platform listings

Creating house manuals and digital guidebooks

Coordinating photography

Reviewing photography

Setting up cleaning requirements

Preparing cleaner checklists

Setting up pricing

Configuring booking rules

Testing guest communications

Conducting final pre-launch checks



The objective is to make sure a new property launches professionally from day one.



6. Cleaning & Turnover Coordination



Our cleaning team is a critical part of the guest experience.



You will help ensure that cleaning schedules accurately reflect reservations and that problems are followed through to completion.



Responsibilities include:



Scheduling cleans based on bookings

Checking for booking changes that affect cleaning schedules

Communicating last-minute changes

Monitoring cleaner reports

Tracking linen requirements

Coordinating restocking of guest consumables

Reviewing reported damage or maintenance issues

Following up on cleaning quality concerns

Recording recurring problems

Escalating serious cleaning issues

Helping maintain consistent presentation standards across the portfolio



You will need to be comfortable communicating clearly and professionally when something has not been completed to the expected standard.



7. Maintenance & Issue Coordination



You will assist the Melbourne team with keeping maintenance issues organised and moving toward resolution.



This may include:



Logging maintenance issues

Gathering information and photos

Communicating with guests

Contacting relevant contractors

Requesting quotes

Seeking owner approval where required

Scheduling access

Following up on incomplete work

Updating guests and owners

Recording completed repairs

Escalating urgent issues to the Melbourne team



An important part of this responsibility is making sure tasks do not disappear simply because the first message has been sent.



We value people who follow an issue through until there is a clear outcome.



8. Administration & Bookkeeping Support



As you develop in the role, you may also assist with financial and administrative processes.



This can include:



Invoice tracking

Receipt organisation

Recording expenses

Tracking owner-reimbursable expenses

Basic account reconciliations

Checking contractor invoices

Supporting owner statement preparation

Maintaining financial trackers

Identifying missing invoices or documentation



Full bookkeeping experience is not required, but strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail are important.



9. Business Growth & New Management Opportunities



As the business continues to grow, there will also be opportunities to assist with bringing new properties into our portfolio.



This may include:



Following up with prospective owners

Maintaining our sales and enquiry pipeline

Preparing information or proposal packs

Conducting property and market research

Gathering comparable listing information

Preparing preliminary revenue information

Tracking follow-ups

Helping ensure potential new clients receive timely communication



Candidates who demonstrate strong communication and commercial skills may take on considerably more responsibility in this area over time.



Working as Part of Our Team



You will be joining a team of six:



Three team members based in Melbourne

Three Virtual Assistants based in the Philippines



We operate as one team rather than treating our offshore team as a separate support function.



You will communicate regularly with both the Melbourne-based team and your fellow VAs, hand over outstanding tasks between shifts, share information about properties and guests, and help ensure nothing is lost between team members.



Because several people may interact with the same reservation or property, clear documentation is extremely important.



We expect team members to:



Leave useful notes for one another

Communicate important developments

Ask questions when something genuinely requires clarification

Make decisions independently when the appropriate process is clear

Escalate appropriately rather than escalating everything

Take responsibility for following through on tasks

Help other team members when workloads change

Look for opportunities to improve our systems

Experience We’re Looking For



We are particularly interested in applicants who have previous short-term rental experience.



Ideally, you have previously:



Worked for a short-term rental or Airbnb management company

Worked as a Virtual Assistant for a short-term rental management business

Managed Airbnb, 
, VRBO, or similar reservations

Communicated directly with short-term rental guests

Coordinated cleaners or turnovers

Worked with a property management system or channel manager

Helped update listings or calendars

Been exposed to dynamic pricing or revenue management



Experience with Australian short-term rentals is a bonus but is not essential.



Candidates with substantial hotel, serviced apartment, hospitality operations, or property management experience may also be considered where the experience is directly relevant.



Tools & Systems



Experience with some of the following would be beneficial:



Airbnb



VRBO

Hostaway

Guesty

Lodgify

Dynamic pricing/revenue management software

Notion

Google Sheets

Microsoft Excel

Dropbox


WhatsApp

Canva



You do not need to know every system we use.



More important is your ability to learn software quickly, follow processes accurately, and understand how different systems connect to the overall operation.



What We're Looking For

Excellent Written English



A large portion of this role involves communicating with guests, owners, cleaners, contractors, and team members.



Your written English should be natural, clear, professional, and appropriate to the situation.



Strong Attention to Detail



Small mistakes in short-term rental management can become large problems.



An incorrect access code, missed cleaner update, wrong date, pricing error, or forgotten maintenance task can directly affect a guest stay or property owner.



We are looking for someone who checks their work.



Calm Under Pressure



Not every day will go according to plan.



Guests may be locked out. Cleaners may be delayed. Appliances may stop working. A booking may arrive unexpectedly. A guest may be frustrated.



We need someone who can remain calm, understand the problem, communicate clearly, and work toward a solution.



Commercial Thinking



We want you to care about how properties perform.



That means thinking about occupancy, nightly rates, reviews, listing quality, guest satisfaction, operating costs, and owner retention rather than seeing each task in isolation.



Ownership



If you identify a problem, we want you to help move it toward a resolution.



If someone needs to be followed up tomorrow, it should be followed up.



If a listing contains incorrect information, it should be corrected.



If a property has several empty nights approaching, we want you to notice.



Reliability



Because this role covers live guest operations, attendance and punctuality are extremely important.



You must have a reliable computer, reliable internet connection, and an appropriate backup plan for reasonable internet or power interruptions.



Ability to Follow Systems — and Improve Them



We have SOPs, templates, checklists, and processes that should be followed.



At the same time, we do not want someone who blindly follows an inefficient process forever.



Once you understand the business, we encourage you to identify improvements and suggest better ways of working.



How Performance Will Be Measured



Performance will be assessed across a combination of operational quality, responsiveness, accuracy, and property performance.



Key indicators may include:



Guest response times

Quality and accuracy of guest communication

Guest satisfaction and review outcomes

Number of preventable operational mistakes

Asset finance product knowledge — equipment finance, chattel mortgage, novated lease, hire purchase, commercial hire purchase, finance lease, operating lease

 Lender portal experience — submitting and tracking applications with major AU asset finance lenders (e.g. Westpac, NAB, ANZ, Macquarie, Pepper Money, Angle Finance, Grow Finance, Shift, ScotPac, Liberty, Fifo Capital)

Income assessment — PAYG, self-employed, company, and trust financials for asset finance purposes

CRM proficiency — Mercury, Salesforce, or comparable broker CRM

Understanding of GST, ABN, and tax implications relevant to asset finance structures

AEST business hours — full-time, Monday to Friday

Minimum Requirements



Strong understanding of chattel mortgage and finance lease structures

Comfortable handling multiple files simultaneously with strict attention to detail and deadlines

Familiar with PPSR (Personal Property Securities Register) searches and registrations

Understanding of responsible lending obligations and privacy requirements under Australian law

Proficient in Microsoft Office — Word, Excel, Outlook

Fast internet connection and professional home office setup





Nice to Have



Experience with novated leasing or fleet finance

Education

A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field is preferred but not required. We value hands-on Australian asset finance experience above qualifications. Candidates without a degree but with 2+ years of direct broker support experience are strongly encouraged to apply.



What We Offer



Competitive base salary based on experience

HMO coverage

Leave credits

13th Month Pay

Career growth — we're building a 50+ person capability centre within 12 months





About the Role

This is a direct broker support role — you work for the broker, not a lender or bank. You are the engine behind the broker's business, managing their asset finance pipeline, keeping deals moving, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks between application and settlement.

You'll be part of Pierian Australia's dedicated back-office capability centre, supporting Australian asset finance brokers across commercial equipment, vehicles, technology, and other asset classes.

)! 



If you work at Wonderist, you likely enjoy a challenge, appreciate autonomy, actually care about clients, and are looking for a team that you can enjoy being part of.



JOB DESCRIPTION:



The Social Ads Associate will play a key role in supporting the launch and management of social advertising campaigns, with a strong focus on creative production, launch administration, QA, request management, and ad hoc support tasks that keep campaigns running smoothly.



This is an excellent entry-level opportunity for someone eager to build a career in digital marketing and social media advertising. You’ll gain hands-on experience with Meta Ads, TikTok-style creative, Canva, video editing, and social ad production while being mentored by senior specialists and collaborating with multiple teams across the agency.



ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:



Creative Production & Asset Support



- Assist with social ad creative production, including building static ads in Canva, editing short-form video content, and preparing creative variations for paid social campaigns.

- Support the creation of ad assets for platforms such as Meta and TikTok, including creative concepts, visual layouts, captions, hooks, and basic video edits.

- Resize, format, organize, and prepare creative assets for campaign launches, refreshes, and testing.

- Follow established templates, brand guidelines, and campaign direction to produce clean, polished creative that aligns with client goals.



Launch Administration & QA For New Accounts



- Follow up with internal teams to gather client assets such as
 page access, ad account access, creative assets, brand guidelines, logos, photos, videos, offers, and landing page details.

- Conduct QA for new social ads campaigns, reviewing creative assets, ad copy, campaign setup, links, landing pages, tracking, and platform connections before launch.

- Support social ads launches by coordinating needed materials, organizing deliverables, and ensuring creative and campaign assets are prepared correctly.



Request Board Management



- Manage incoming social ads requests from client success and internal teams through the request board.

- Blend task completion, task routing, and task follow-up to ensure requests are handled efficiently and on time.

- Support strategic pivots such as new campaign launches, creative refreshes, campaign angle changes, and offer updates by coordinating with team members and ensuring deliverables are prepared correctly.



Ad Hoc Requests



- Monitor and troubleshoot basic account, access, creative, or platform-related issues, coordinating with internal teams to resolve them.

- Assist with gathering creative assets, client documentation, campaign notes, or platform access needed to complete social ads work.

- Support ad hoc requests such as slide deck preparation, reporting needs, creative audits, campaign updates, and social ads production tasks.



Additional Responsibilities



- Contribute to cross-team projects, process improvements, and new initiatives as assigned.

- Take on new responsibilities and special projects as business needs evolve, with opportunities to learn and grow.



CORE COMPETENCIES:



Attention to Detail: Catches small errors in creative, copy, links, campaign setup, or reporting before they become bigger issues.



Organizational Skills: Manages multiple tasks, creative requests, assets, and deadlines with clarity and efficiency.



Communication: Shares updates clearly with internal teams and asks thoughtful questions when clarification is needed.



Problem-Solving: Approaches challenges with curiosity and resourcefulness, seeking solutions rather than roadblocks.



Adaptability: Comfortable shifting focus as client or business needs change, and open to taking on new tasks.



Collaboration: Works well across departments, including Client Success, Design, Web, SEO, and Paid Media, to ensure campaigns align with broader client goals.



Initiative: Proactively follows up on tasks, takes ownership of assigned responsibilities, and looks for ways to add value.



Creative Aptitude: Has an eye for clean, effective creative and is willing to learn how to produce social ad assets that are clear, engaging, and aligned with campaign goals.



Technical Aptitude: Willing to learn new platforms and tools quickly, with a foundation in digital marketing and social media concepts.



PERSONALITY MUSTS:



Our perfect fit is someone who is a problem solver who understands the difference between “yes, and…” and “yes, but…”. You should have a hungry, scrappy personality with a positive attitude and aim to deliver. Working in the client service industry can mean going the extra mile, and we need someone who is always willing to rise to the occasion for our clients and put forward beautiful work that exceeds client expectations. Someone who is detailed and organized, driven, displays vigor, and comes ready to play every day. Confidence, self-discipline, and a congenial, curious mind are things we love and admire.



The ideal Social Ads Associate is curious, detail-oriented, creative, and eager to learn. You’re someone who takes initiative, asks questions, and thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. You should be organized, proactive, and ready to roll up your sleeves to support both the team and clients. A positive attitude, hunger to grow, and willingness to take ownership are a must.

title: SEO Link Builder / Outreach Specialist – Video Gaming Niche (Part-Time, Long-Term)
description:
We are looking for a relationship-driven SEO Link Builder / Outreach Specialist to take ownership of backlink acquisition for a growing Australian ecommerce business in the video gaming niche.

Right now, most of our link acquisition runs through vendors and resellers, which means we pay a markup on nearly every placement. This role exists to bring that work in-house and turn it into a structured, direct process. You will prospect relevant websites yourself, build relationships with publishers and site owners, negotiate placements at direct rates, and manage a monthly placement budget of around 2,000–5,000 USD.



This is not a mass-outreach or link-blasting role. We care more about 5–10 relevant, properly vetted placements than a hundred cheap ones. You should be comfortable walking away from a link that looks good on paper but does not pass a proper quality check.



Responsibilities



Prospecting & Outreach

- Identify relevant, quality websites in the video gaming niche and related verticals for link opportunities, including guest - posts, niche edits, resource pages, and partnerships

- Run personalised outreach and follow-up sequences that generate replies

Negotiation & Publisher Relationships

- Manage our monthly placement budget of around 2,000–5,000 USD and maximise the quality of links secured

- Set up repeat-placement or bulk arrangements with publishers where appropriate



Link Quality Vetting

- Vet every opportunity before committing, including niche relevance, organic traffic, traffic trends, outbound link profile, - dofollow/nofollow/sponsored status, and anchor text

- Verify placements go live as agreed and remain live



Tracking & Reporting

- Keep our backlink tracker fully up to date, including prospect status, outreach progress, cost, anchor, target URL, and - live/lost checks

- Maintain clear records of publisher quotes and agreed placement terms

- Report cost per link and key quality metrics monthly



Community & Organic Mentions

- When time permits, participate naturally in relevant Reddit, gaming forum, and community discussions where our brand or - content genuinely adds value

- This is a minor side responsibility. Direct outreach and placements always come first



Role Scope

- This role is focused on link acquisition, outreach, and link quality. It does not involve on-page SEO, technical SEO, or content - writing beyond outreach
s and brief community replies.

- You will not be reselling links to us through your own vendor network. We are hiring you to prospect and negotiate directly - with publishers on our behalf, with full transparency around placement costs.



Required Experience

- 2+ years of hands-on link building or outreach experience with results you can show

- Strong prospecting skills and the ability to identify relevant websites within a niche

- Confident using Ahrefs or Semrush and spotting inflated or spammy sites

Hours and Benefits

- Monday to Friday, 4 hours per day at set times agreed in advance

Application Questions

3. Share three links you personally secured: the URL, how you found the opportunity, how you secured the placement, and what it cost if paid.

title: LLM Application Developer — Therapeutic AI Companion App
description:
AI Developer Needed — Therapeutic AI Companion App 

This is a gig with the potential to turn into a full-time job



The Project



I've developed an original therapeutic model and, working closely with Claude/Anthropic's AI over many months, built and extensively tested an AI therapeutic companion character called "Hi." The character, its full clinical manual, response rules, and safety architecture already exist and have been tested through hundreds of hours of real conversation. I'm now looking for a developer to turn this into a real, deployable app.



This is not a "build me a chatbot" job. The character, the clinical content, and the behavioral rules are already written and refined. What I need is someone who can build the technical infrastructure to make it work reliably, repeatably, and safely for many users - not just in one good conversation, but consistently, at scale.



What You'd Be Building



- A chat application where users have ongoing conversations with "Hi"

- Full manual/clinical content available as context for every response (RAG or full-context approach — we'll discuss which fits best)

- Persistent memory per user across sessions - not just within one conversation, but real continuity over weeks and months

- A pinned, specific AI model version (not one that silently updates and changes behavior without warning)

- A distinct safety/crisis-detection layer that sits outside the character itself and can escalate to real human resources

- An automated testing pipeline that checks new versions/changes against a set of known behavioral tests before anything goes live to real users



What You Need to Know - please do not apply if you don't have proof of having all the experiences listed below:



- Experience building applications on top of LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI, or similar) — you understand system prompts, context windows, and RAG/retrieval architectures

- Experience with persistent data storage (a real database — this app needs to remember individual users over time, not reset every session)

- Understanding of, or willingness to learn, prompt engineering well enough to preserve a very specific, carefully-tuned character voice — this is not generic chatbot work; behavioral and Hi personality consistency is the hardest and most important part of this project

- Comfort building basic automated testing/evaluation systems (running a fixed set of test conversations against any new version before deployment)

- Ideally: some familiarity with mental-health-adjacent product considerations (crisis handling, appropriate disclaimers, data privacy) — or willingness to research and implement this carefully



What Matters Most to Me



- Reliability - I need something that behaves consistently, not something with the most features.

- Respect for the clinical content.- You'll be working with detailed, sensitive clinical material. An NDA and clear IP agreement will be required before any materials are shared - everything in the manual is original work.

- Communication.- I'm not a developer. I need someone who can explain technical tradeoffs in plain language and who is patient with genuine, detailed feedback - this project has already gone through extensive iterative testing and refinement, and that process continues.



Scope and Structure



- Initial build: a working web app (mobile-app packaging should come later)

- I can provide a clear technical brief, the full clinical manual, tested behavioral rules, and a set of test conversations/probes to validate against

- Ongoing relationship preferred over one-and-done — this will need iteration and support as we learn from real users

        

Payment structure: milestone-based.



Rather than hourly billing, I'd like to structure payment around clear, deliverable milestones — for example:



Core chat interface working, connected to the AI model, using the provided manual/character content

Persistent memory system implemented — the app remembers individual users across separate sessions

Safety/crisis-detection layer integrated and tested

Automated testing pipeline built, validating behavior against a provided set of test conversations

Deployment-ready polish and launch



Each milestone will have an agreed price based on hours that you worked, and clear criteria for "done" (working, tested, matching the behavioral requirements) before payment for that stage. I'm open to discussing this structure — if you have a different approach that's worked well for you on similar projects, I'd like to hear it.



To Apply



Please share:

- Relevant experience with LLM-based applications (links to past work is a must)

- Your approach to handling persistent memory and context management at scale

- Any experience with sensitive/regulated content (health, mental health, or similar)

- Your typical working/communication style



I'm looking for someone thoughtful, technically strong, and genuinely interested in doing this.



Finally, if your experience doesn't match all the requirements that I described above, please don't write me. I am not looking for someone who is willing to learn and has "some" experience. I am looking for someone who is a pro, with years of experience and knows what they are doing. This is a mental health app where distressed people will come for help. This needs to work in a super reliable way; otherwise, it may cause harm. So I am not willing to experiment with someone who is new to the industry or doesn't have all that it takes to build it. Thank you for understanding.

title: Technical Project Manager (WordPress/WooCommerce)
description:
We are looking for an exceptionally organised Technical Project Manager to take ownership of project coordination, tracking, and delivery across the development team of a growing Australian ecommerce business.



This is a full-time, long-term role.



Our development work spans three connected applications: our live ecommerce site, a separate order fulfilment application, and a marketplace platform we are preparing to launch. We work with a distributed team of developers, a QA specialist, and a design team.



Right now, project management sits with our Tech Lead on top of his development responsibilities. This role exists to take that responsibility over and turn it into a structured, reliable process. You will own task management in ClickUp, assign and distribute work, track deadlines, follow up daily, coordinate QA and releases, verify developer work reports, and give management a clear, accurate view of exactly where every project stands.



This is not a tech lead or development role. Our Tech Lead owns all technical and architecture decisions, code review, and the development itself. Your role sits around the development: making sure every task has an owner, every deadline is tracked, every blocker is surfaced and removed, and nothing falls through the cracks.



Your core mission is finding and removing bottlenecks. You should be comfortable chasing down why something is delayed, not just reporting that it is.



Responsibilities:



Task & Project Management

- Own ClickUp end to end: task ownership, priorities, statuses, due dates, dependencies, blockers, defect progress, and release status must always be accurate and up to date

- Log and triage all incoming work, bringing development requests, feature requests, and bug reports into a clean, organised queue ready to be assigned

- Assign and distribute tasks to developers (with technical input from our Tech Lead) and keep an ample backlog ready so no developer is ever waiting for work

- Track deadlines, update timelines when things change, and keep everything on track



Developer Coordination & Accountability

- Follow up on active tasks daily and hold developers and vendors accountable for delivering on time and to our standard

- Review PR turnaround, ensuring pull requests are completed and reviewed in a timely manner

- Review developer hourly summaries against the actual work delivered and perform due diligence on what we are billed

- Continually gather feedback from every developer, surface problems early, and remove bottlenecks before they cost us time



QA & Release Coordination

- Ensure every defect QA identifies has a clear owner, is tracked, followed up on, escalated if delayed, and retested

- Manage the "Ready for QA" handoff so QA testing is never blocked by unfinished work

- Track the weekly go-live and deployment status: is it on track, what is blocking it, and who owns what

- Coordinate work across the live environment, staging, and all three applications



Design Coordination

- When developers need mockups for a new page or flow, ensure the design team delivers them on time so developers are never waiting on creatives



Process & Documentation

- Build and maintain your own systems, SOPs, and checklists to make sure our processes are followed consistently

- Document workflows as you learn them, building a clear project management playbook

- Identify repetitive or inefficient processes that could be improved, standardised, or automated



Role Scope 

You will not make technical or architecture decisions; the Tech Lead owns those. Your input is welcome, and if you have opinions when edge cases or implementation approaches are being discussed, we want to hear them, but the final call always sits with the Tech Lead.



You will not write or review code, and you do not need to be a full-stack developer. Your responsibility is coordination, tracking, follow-up, accountability, and giving management an accurate view of project health at all times.



Required Experience

- 2+ years in project management, delivery management, or a similar coordination role with software/development teams

- Some development background or strong technical understanding, enough to follow technical discussions, understand how the parts of a system connect, and properly manage tickets, priorities, timelines, QA, and communication. You do not need to be able to build it yourself

- Experience with ClickUp, or with Jira/Asana and the ability to master ClickUp quickly

- Exceptional organisation and attention to detail. Your personal tracking must be flawless: every detail, every task, every responsibility accounted for, nothing ever missed

- A hawk eye on everything. You are comfortable watching every moving piece at once and following up every single day if that is what it takes to get things done

- Independent and self-directed. You build your own systems rather than waiting to be told what to check

- Strong written and spoken English. Your updates need to be clear and easy to act on



Only apply if you are exceptional in organisation and follow-through. If you are not, this role will not work out.



Strongly Preferred

- Experience managing remote or distributed development teams

- Experience with ecommerce platforms or multi-application projects

- Hands-on development experience in any stack

- Experience working alongside QA and structured testing processes

- Experience holding external vendors or agencies accountable

- Experience working with Australian businesses



Hours and Benefits

- Monday to Friday schedule, we'll agree on a roster

- Paid vacation leave after three months

- Performance-based pay increases over time

- Stable, long-term role with a growing Australian company

- A newly created position with real ownership and the opportunity to build the project management systems this team runs on as the business grows

- $800-$1000 USD (Depending on experience)



Application Questions

1. Describe your project management experience with software or development teams, including team sizes, the tools you used, and exactly what you were responsible for.

2. Describe the personal system you use to make sure nothing you are responsible for is ever missed. Be specific.

3. A developer's task is due tomorrow and they have not responded to your follow-up message today. Walk us through, step by step, what you would do.

4. A developer's hourly summary bills six hours for a task, but the delivered work looks much smaller. How would you handle this?

5. QA reports a defect but it is unclear which developer's work caused it. What do you do?

6. What is your experience with ClickUp (or Jira/Asana)? Give specific examples of what you have set up or managed.

7. In your own words, walk us through what typically happens between a developer finishing a piece of work and that work going live for users.

8. Briefly describe your technical or development background.

9. Please include a link to your LinkedIn profile if you have one.

Please begin your application with HAWKEYE so we know you have read the full job description.

title: Senior Video Editor (YouTube)
description:
WHO WE ARE

NIA Production is a YouTube conglomerate. We own, build, and operate our own channels in-house. Every channel we run is ours.

You can see our work at 



We are 90+ people strong and growing rapidly. Most of our team is hybrid and we hire globally. We move fast. We care about results, and we hire people who think the same way.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

NIA Production doesn't launch channels by guessing what works; we build repeatable systems backed by audience data.

The Experimental Channel Video Editor/Channel Launch Editor exists to develop the editing formula behind every new YouTube channel we launch. Rather than maintaining an established editing style, you'll identify what keeps viewers watching, test competing creative approaches, and turn successful experiments into documented systems that other editors can execute consistently.

Once a channel's editing formula has been proven and handed off, you'll move on to the next experimental channel and repeat the process. Your success isn't measured by how many videos you edit, rather it's measured by how many successful editing systems you create.



HOW THIS ROLE WORKS

Each engagement follows the same cycle:

Discovery and competitor research. Align on goals and audience, tear down 8 to 15 competitor channels (plus any channels outside the niche whose packaging approach could be useful to intergrate), and document which visual patterns work. 

Concept development. Build mood boards and concept options, then commit to one direction.

Pilot videos. Edit benchmark videos to prove the style works in a real edit, not just in mockups.

Style package and template build. Package the style guide and all reusable assets so someone else can run it without you.

Handoff and training. Train the incoming editor, answer their questions, and guide them accordingly through the transition, then move to the next channel.



RESPONSIBILITIES

Research and creative direction. Study the top-performing videos in the niche and work out the editing mechanics behind their retention: how the first 15 to 30 seconds are built, where cuts speed up or slow down, how b-roll and sound design hold attention. Turn that into a direction covering pacing, hook structure, text and graphics, music, and SFX. You pitch this direction and you defend it, with reasoning specific to that niche rather than copying what worked elsewhere.

Niche and channel mastery. Develop a deep, working understanding of both the niche and the specific channel you're building, deep enough to know what will work before testing it. Take what's proven to work elsewhere and adapt it so it fits this channel specifically, and originate new ideas where the niche has a gap, so the channel stands out rather than blends in. 

Pilot editing. Prove the style in real edits. Take raw, unstructured footage and turn it into videos with a strong hook and intentional pacing.

Testing and optimization. Run structured tests between competing approaches, such as two different openings or pacing styles, and use average view duration and retention data to d
 what becomes the standard. When a style is not working, flag it early and propose a new direction instead of repeating what has already failed.

Systemizing and handing off. Build the infrastructure the channel needs to move fast: intro templates, title and caption styles, SFX libraries, transition presets, project templates. Document the formula, train the editor who inherits it, and leave notes detailed enough for them to hold the retention curve without guessing at your reasoning.

Team coordination and delivery. Coordinate with the team, always meet turnaround times, keep up great communication, and be reliable. As we scale, this includes managing and coordinating any additional designers brought on to support volume.

Proactive growth mindset. Be proactive and obsessed with self-improvement, pushing to get better each day.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

This is about the kind of person you are, not just the tasks.

You are not a stylist. You do not have one signature look you apply to everything. A fast-cut challenge channel and a slow cinematic one need different instincts, and you have both.

You are not a maintainer. You like working out the formula, not running it. If you need one channel to settle into, the constant handoffs will wear on you.

You are not an order-taker. You do not just cut what you are handed. You push back on footage that cannot support retention and defend a direction with reasoning.

You are not attached to your edit. Your taste is not the standard. A retention graph can prove you wrong, and you accept it when it does.

You are not a lone wolf. You do not make yourself valuable by being the only one who can recreate your edit. You build so someone else can take over.



REQUIREMENTS



Must-Have:

A portfolio of real, published YouTube edits, ideally across more than one niche or format, since this role will not stay on one type of content.

A track record of turning raw, unstructured footage into compelling videos with a strong hook and intentional pacing, not just polishing footage already shot to a script.

Strong ability to read retention graphs: spotting the exact 
nt viewers dropped off, explaining why, and tying it to a specific editing decision.

Demonstrated versatility, with evidence of adapting your pacing and style across genuinely different content instead of applying one signature style to everything.

The ability to watch a competitor's video and go into full technical detail which editing decisions are driving retention, rather than just saying it feels well edited.

Strong motion graphics ability and working knowledge of AI tools relevant to editing and production.

Ability to manage your own workload across more than one channel without close oversight.

You genuinely enjoy hard challenges. Working out a retention formula from raw, untested footage is difficult and full of dead ends, and you are the kind of person who is drawn to that rather than worn down by it.



Nice-to-Have:

You have launched a channel from its earliest uploads, building the editing style and format from scratch instead of joining an established show.

You have built reusable editing systems (templates, presets, SFX libraries) that other editors actually adopted.

You have trained someone or handed off work before. 



RESULTS



Success in this role is measured by:

Average view duration and retention improve and hold across multiple uploads, not on one standout edit.

Every channel you work on ends up with a documented editing system the team can run without you.

Your tests produce clear, data-backed winners the team can confidently standardize.

You move through channels at a healthy pace instead of staying on one longer than needed.

Your handoff notes are clear enough that another editor understands the reasoning behind every major decision and can hold the retention performance without extra guidance.

You coordinate well with the team and continue to be proactive in surfacing issues that affect the channel’s success.

If you're someone who enjoys solving problems, learning new systems, and continuously improving, we'd love to hear from you.





Important



We need someone who wants to build a long-term career with us. While we understand that many virtual assistants work with multiple clients, preference will be given to applicants who can fully commit to our team. As our business continues to grow, we're looking for people who want to grow with us: not just fill available hours.



If you're dependable, eager to learn, and consistently perform at a high level, there is significant opportunity for increased hours, additional responsibilities, and long-term growth within the company.





Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who:



* Has excellent written English with strong grammar, spelling, and communication skills.

* Learns quickly and enjoys mastering new systems and processes.

* Is proactive and takes initiative instead of waiting to be told what to do.

* Can work independently with minimal supervision.

* Is resourceful and knows how to find answers before asking for help.

* Accepts feedback professionally and applies it immediately.

* Is adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where processes continue to improve.

* Is willing to unlearn habits from previous companies and fully adopt our workflows, SOPs, and standards.

* Takes pride in producing high-quality work instead of simply completing a shift.

* Is looking for a long-term opportunity rather than just another VA job.



We believe skills can be taught. A strong work ethic and great attitude are much harder to teach.



Preferred Experience



Experience in the following is a plus:



* Shopify

* Loop Subscriptions

* Checkout Champ

* Ecommerce Customer Cupport

* Subscription-based businesses

* Gorgias, Commslayer, Richpanel, Zendesk, Re:amaze, Front, or similar helpdesk platforms



If you don't have experience with every tool listed above, that's okay. We provide training for the right candidate.



Responsibilities



You'll be responsible for:



* Responding to customer
s professionally and empathetically.

* Resolving customer concerns efficiently.

* Handling order updates, shipping inquiries, refunds, replacements, subscriptions, and product questions.

* Following company SOPs while adapting to new processes as the business grows.

* Delivering a consistently excellent customer experience.



Compensation & Growth



* Starting rate: $4 USD/hour

* New hires will begin on a part-time trial period

* High-performing team members who consistently demonstrate reliability, initiative, and strong performance will have the opportunity to transition into a full-time position (40-48 hours/week)

* Performance bonuses and opportunities for career growth as the company continues to expand.



We're looking for someone who wants to grow with the company.

Preference will be given to applicants who are able to make our team their primary work commitment.





Our Hiring Process



We invest heavily in building a strong team, so our hiring process is designed to identify candidates who are willing to learn and grow.



1. Submit your application.

2. Selected applicants will receive a short application form.

3. Top candidates will be invited for an interview.

4. Successful interviewees will receive access to our learning materials for a self-paced learning period (approximately one week).

5. Before the end of that week, you'll complete a timed mock customer support assessment based on the materials provided.

6. Candidates who successfully pass the assessment will proceed to paid training stage, with the opportunity to become a long-term member of our team.



Please note: The evaluation stage is designed to assess your ability to learn, follow SOPs, and apply new knowledge.

Only candidates who successfully pass this stage will move on to paid training.



Requirements



* At least 18 years old.

* Fluent in written English.

* Strong grammar and communication skills.

* Reliable computer and internet connection.

* Able to work independently.

* Eager to learn and continuously improve.

* Ecommerce customer service experience is preferred but not required.





How to Apply

To confirm you've read this entire job post, please:



1. Include the word RED at the beginning of your application title.



2. Answer the following questions:



* What motivates you to do great work?

* Why do you want to work with our company?

* Tell us about a time you had to learn something completely new. How did you approach it?

* What do you believe makes excellent customer service?

* How do you usually handle constructive feedback?

* If you don't know the answer to a customer's question, what would you do?



3. Bonus Exercise

A customer sends the following
:



"I've already
ed twice and nobody has helped me. This is honestly very frustrating."



Write the response you would send to this customer.



We carefully review every application.



Thoughtful answers matter much more than generic responses or years of experience.

title: AU Asset Finance
description:
Asset Finance Support



Remote / Work from Home |AEST Hours | Supporting Australian Asset Finance Brokers



To Apply, please submit this form: forms.cloud.microsoft/r/1MQsTx8TQa



Who We're Looking For

We're building a dedicated team of asset finance support professionals to work directly with Australian asset finance brokers. If you have hands-on experience processing equipment, vehicle, or commercial asset finance applications and understand the end-to-end broker workflow, we want to hear from you.



What You'll Be Doing Every Day

Managing asset finance files end-to-end — from initial client enquiry through to settlement and post-settlement

Data entry and file management in broker CRM platforms (Mercury, Salesforce, or equivalent)

Preparing and submitting finance applications to lenders via broker portals

Ordering and tracking asset valuations and credit assessments

Requesting and tracking pricing and rate concessions from lenders

Running asset finance calculators — balloon payments, residual values, comparison rates, repayment schedules

Preparing compliance documents, credit diary notes, settlement letters, and payout figures

Ordering and interpreting commercial credit reports (e.g. Equifax, CreditorWatch, Veda)

Coordinating with lenders, vendors, dealers, and clients throughout the approval and settlement process

Managing discharge and payout requests, PPSR checks, and ASIC searches

Preparing funds-to-complete confirmations and settlement instructions

Post-settlement tasks — invoice reconciliation, asset registration follow-up, client retention



You Must Have

2–3 years of experience in Australian asset finance — broker-side, not lender operations

Asset finance product knowledge — equipment finance, chattel mortgage, novated lease, hire purchase, commercial hire purchase, finance lease, operating lease

Lender portal experience — submitting and tracking applications with major AU asset finance lenders (e.g. Westpac, NAB, ANZ, Macquarie, Pepper Money, Angle Finance, Grow Finance, Shift, ScotPac, Liberty, Fifo Capital)

Income assessment — PAYG, self-employed, company, and trust financials for asset finance purposes

CRM proficiency — Mercury, Salesforce, or comparable broker CRM

Understanding of GST, ABN, and tax implications relevant to asset finance structures

AEST business hours — full-time, Monday to Friday

Excellent written and spoken English — direct communication with brokers, clients, and lenders



Minimum Requirements

Strong understanding of chattel mortgage and finance lease structures

Comfortable handling multiple files simultaneously with strict attention to detail and deadlines

Familiar with PPSR (Personal Property Securities Register) searches and registrations

Understanding of responsible lending obligations and privacy requirements under Australian law

Proficient in Microsoft Office — Word, Excel, Outlook

Fast internet connection and professional home office setup





Nice to Have

Experience with novated leasing or fleet finance

Exposure to construction equipment, yellow goods, or specialised asset classes

Familiarity with commercial property-backed asset finance

Experience using ApplyOnline, Loanapp, or Simpology for commercial submissions

Cert IV in Finance & Mortgage Broking or equivalent





Education

A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field is preferred but not required. We value hands-on Australian asset finance experience above qualifications. Candidates without a degree but with 2+ years of direct broker support experience are strongly encouraged to apply.



What We Offer

Competitive base salary based on experience

HMO coverage

Leave credits

13th Month Pay

Career growth — we're building a 50+ person capability centre within 12 months





About the Role

This is a direct broker support role — you work for the broker, not a lender or bank. You are the engine behind the broker's business, managing their asset finance pipeline, keeping deals moving, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks between application and settlement.

You'll be part of Pierian Australia's dedicated back-office capability centre, supporting Australian asset finance brokers across commercial equipment, vehicles, technology, and other asset classes.
